records.literal_gloss: Concerning Moab. Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: Woe to Nebo, for it is devastated; is put to shame, is captured Kiriathaim; is put to shame the stronghold, and is shattered.

en.L: Concerning Moab. Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo, for it is devastated! \q Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is captured; \q the stronghold is put to shame and shattered.
en.B: Concerning Moab. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Woe to Nebo, for it lies in ruins! \q Kiriathaim is disgraced and captured; \q the stronghold is disgraced and shattered.
en.R: This message is about Moab. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: How terrible it will be for Nebo! It is destroyed. \q Kiriathaim is captured, and its people are put to shame. \q The fortress is put to shame and torn down.

es.L: Acerca de Moab. Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: ¡Ay de Nebo, porque ha sido devastada! \q Avergonzada, tomada está Quiriataim; \q avergonzada está la fortaleza, y destrozada.
es.B: Acerca de Moab. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: ¡Ay de Nebo, porque está en ruinas! \q Quiriataim está humillada y conquistada; \q la fortaleza está humillada y destrozada.
es.R: Este mensaje es acerca de Moab. Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: ¡Qué terrible será para Nebo! Está destruida. \q Quiriataim ha sido conquistada, y su gente avergonzada. \q La fortaleza está avergonzada y derribada.

fr.L: Sur Moab. Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Malheur, Nebo, car elle est dévastée ! \q Qiryathaïm est couverte de honte, elle est prise ; \q la citadelle est couverte de honte et brisée.
fr.B: Au sujet de Moab. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Malheur à Nebo, car elle est en ruine ! \q Qiryathaïm est déshonorée et prise ; \q la citadelle est déshonorée et abattue.
fr.R: Ce message concerne Moab. Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Quel malheur pour Nebo ! Elle est détruite. \q Qiryathaïm est prise, et ses habitants sont couverts de honte. \q La forteresse est couverte de honte et démolie.

sw.L: Kuhusu Moabu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi, Mungu wa Israeli: Ole, Nebo, kwa maana umeharibiwa! \q Kiriathaimu imeaibishwa, imetwaliwa; \q ngome imeaibishwa na kuvunjwa.
sw.B: Kuhusu Moabu. Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Ole wake Nebo, kwa maana umekuwa magofu! \q Kiriathaimu imeaibishwa na kutekwa; \q ngome imeaibishwa na kuvunjwa.
sw.R: Ujumbe huu ni kuhusu Moabu. Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa Nebo! Umeangamizwa. \q Kiriathaimu imetekwa, na watu wake wameaibishwa. \q Ngome imeaibishwa na kubomolewa.

vi.L: Về Mô-áp. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Khốn cho Nê-bô, vì nó bị tàn phá! \q Ki-ri-a-ta-im bị hổ thẹn, bị chiếm lấy; \q đồn lũy bị hổ thẹn và bị đập tan.
vi.B: Về Mô-áp. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Khốn cho Nê-bô, vì nó đã thành đống đổ nát! \q Ki-ri-a-ta-im bị nhục nhã và bị chiếm; \q đồn lũy bị nhục nhã và bị đập tan.
vi.R: Sứ điệp này nói về Mô-áp. Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Thật khốn khổ cho Nê-bô! Nó đã bị tàn phá. \q Ki-ri-a-ta-im bị chiếm, dân nó bị sỉ nhục. \q Đồn lũy bị sỉ nhục và bị phá đổ.

ko.L: 모압에 관하여. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 느보에게 화가 있다. 그것이 황폐해졌다! \q 기랴다임이 수치를 당하고 점령되었다. \q 요새가 수치를 당하고 부서졌다.
ko.B: 모압에 관한 말씀이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 느보에게 화가 있다. 그 성이 폐허가 되었다! \q 기랴다임이 치욕을 당하고 점령되었다. \q 요새가 치욕을 당하고 무너졌다.
ko.R: 이것은 모압에 관한 말씀이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 하시는 말씀이다. 느보에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! 그 성은 멸망했다. \q 기랴다임은 점령되고, 그 백성은 수치를 당했다. \q 요새는 수치를 당하고 허물어졌다.

decisions.choice: Moab: the nation east of the Dead Sea; Nebo: one of its towns
decisions.reason: Chapter 48 is the oracle on Moab among the oracles on the nations (46-51). Moab lay east of the Dead Sea, between the Arnon and the Zered, and in this period held the plateau north of the Arnon as well. Nebo here is the town of that name (Numbers 32:3, 38), not the mountain. Much of the chapter takes up Isaiah 15-16, the earlier oracle on Moab, and the notes name those places.

decisions.choice: woe: a cry of grief and doom over Nebo
decisions.reason: The word is the cry of mourning used over the dead (22:18) and in the prophets over those facing judgment (22:13; 23:1; Isaiah 1:4).

decisions.choice: is devastated ... captured ... shattered: the fall pictured as already done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the completed form, the way prophecy speaks of what is certain to come. Kiriathaim was a town of the plateau (Numbers 32:37; Joshua 13:19); with Nebo it is also named in the inscription of Mesha, king of Moab in the ninth century BC.

decisions.choice: the stronghold: a high, secure place, not a town's name
decisions.reason: The word means a height or refuge and is used of God as a stronghold (Psalm 46:8). With the article it most likely means Moab's fortress, or Kiriathaim's own citadel. Some take it as a place name, Misgab, since it stands among towns; no town of that name is known.

decisions.choice: disgraced (B); put to shame (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means both to be shamed and to be dried up or brought to nothing. Literal and Readable keep "put to shame"; Balanced uses "disgraced" for the same sense.

decisions.choice: This message is about Moab
decisions.reason: Readable turns the heading into a sentence and says "How terrible it will be" for "woe", as Isaiah and Jeremiah do elsewhere.

decisions.choice: ¡Ay de Nebo! (L, B); ¡Qué terrible será para Nebo! (R)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* as set in the terms note. Moab's towns take the forms of the published Pentateuch and Joshua (Nebo, Quiriataim, Hesbón, Dibón, Aroer, el Arnón).

decisions.choice: "Ole, ..." (L); "Ole wake ..." (B); "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ..." (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for *hoy* in the Swahili prophets, as Luke 6:24.

decisions.choice: "Malheur, Nebo" (L); "Malheur à Nebo" (B); "Quel malheur pour Nebo !" (R)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* as the French terms note sets it for the oracles.

decisions.choice: Khốn cho (L, B); Thật khốn khổ cho (R)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* as a threat is set as "Khốn cho ... / Thật khốn khổ cho ..." for these books; the towns of Moab are written as Joshua 13 and 1 Chronicles 5 have them.

decisions.choice: "~에게 화가 있다" (L, B); "~에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다" (R) for *hoy*
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for *hoy* when it threatens.

decisions.choice: "요새" for *misgab*
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: a high secure place, not a town's name.

source.text: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: No more [is the] praise of Moab; in Heshbon they have planned against her evil: Come, and let us cut her off from [being a] nation. Also, Madmen, you will be silenced; after you will go [the] sword.

en.L: There is no more praise of Moab; \q in Heshbon they have planned evil against her: \q "Come, and let us cut her off from [being] a nation." \q You also, Madmen, will be silenced; \q after you the sword will go.
en.B: Moab's renown is gone. \q In Heshbon they have plotted disaster against her: \q "Come, let us wipe her out as a nation." \q You too, Madmen, will be silenced; \q the sword will pursue you.
en.R: No one praises Moab anymore. \q In Heshbon the enemy makes evil plans against Moab: \q "Come, let us destroy Moab, so that it is no longer a nation." \q The town of Madmen will also be silenced. \q Enemy soldiers will chase its people with swords.

es.L: Ya no hay alabanza de Moab; \q en Hesbón planearon mal contra ella: \q «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y cortémosla para que no sea nación». \q También tú, Madmén, serás silenciada; \q tras de ti irá la espada.
es.B: La fama de Moab se acabó. \q En Hesbón tramaron su desgracia: \q «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, borrémosla como nación». \q Tú también, Madmén, serás silenciada; \q la espada te perseguirá.
es.R: Ya nadie alaba a Moab. \q En Hesbón el enemigo hace planes malvados contra Moab: \q «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, destruyamos a Moab para que deje de ser una nación». \q La ciudad de Madmén también será silenciada. \q Los soldados enemigos perseguirán a su gente con la espada.

fr.L: Il n’y a plus de louange pour Moab ; \q à Heshbon on a projeté du mal contre elle : \q « Venez, et retranchons-la, qu’elle ne soit plus une nation. » \q Toi aussi, Madmen, tu seras réduite au silence ; \q derrière toi ira l’épée.
fr.B: La gloire de Moab n’est plus. \q À Heshbon, on a comploté sa perte : \q « Venez, supprimons-la du rang des nations. » \q Toi aussi, Madmen, tu seras réduite au silence ; \q l’épée te poursuivra.
fr.R: Plus personne ne fait l’éloge de Moab. \q À Heshbon, l’ennemi fait de mauvais projets contre Moab : \q « Venez, détruisons Moab, pour qu’il ne soit plus une nation. » \q La ville de Madmen aussi sera réduite au silence. \q Les soldats ennemis poursuivront ses habitants avec leurs épées.

sw.L: Hakuna tena sifa ya Moabu; \q huko Heshboni wamepanga mabaya juu yake: \q "Njooni, tumkatilie mbali asiwe taifa." \q Wewe nawe, Madmeni, utanyamazishwa; \q upanga utakufuatia.
sw.B: Sifa ya Moabu imetoweka. \q Huko Heshboni wamepanga maafa juu yake: \q "Njooni, tumfutilie mbali kama taifa." \q Wewe nawe, Madmeni, utanyamazishwa; \q upanga utakufuatia.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayeisifu Moabu tena. \q Huko Heshboni adui wanapanga mabaya juu ya Moabu: \q "Njooni, tuiangamize Moabu, isiwe taifa tena." \q Mji wa Madmeni nao utanyamazishwa. \q Askari wa adui watawafukuza watu wake kwa panga.

vi.L: Mô-áp không còn được ca ngợi nữa; \q tại Hết-bôn người ta mưu điều ác nghịch cùng nó: \q "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy diệt nó, không cho làm một dân tộc nữa." \q Hỡi Mát-mên, ngươi cũng sẽ bị làm cho câm lặng; \q gươm sẽ đuổi theo ngươi.
vi.B: Danh tiếng Mô-áp không còn nữa. \q Tại Hết-bôn người ta bày mưu hại nó: \q "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy xóa sổ nó khỏi hàng các dân tộc." \q Hỡi Mát-mên, ngươi cũng sẽ bị làm cho câm lặng; \q gươm sẽ đuổi theo ngươi.
vi.R: Không ai còn ca ngợi Mô-áp nữa. \q Tại Hết-bôn quân thù bày mưu ác chống lại Mô-áp: \q "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy hủy diệt Mô-áp, để nó không còn là một dân tộc nữa." \q Thành Mát-mên cũng sẽ phải im lặng. \q Quân thù sẽ cầm gươm đuổi theo dân thành ấy.

ko.L: 모압을 칭송하는 일이 다시는 없다. \q 헤스본에서 그들이 그를 해치려고 악을 꾀했다. \q "오너라, 그를 끊어 민족이 되지 못하게 하자." \q 맛멘아, 너도 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 칼이 너를 뒤쫓아 갈 것이다.
ko.B: 모압의 명성은 사라졌다. \q 헤스본에서 그들이 모압을 해칠 재앙을 꾀했다. \q "자, 모압을 없애서 다시는 민족이 되지 못하게 하자." \q 맛멘아, 너도 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 칼이 너를 뒤쫓을 것이다.
ko.R: 이제는 아무도 모압을 칭찬하지 않는다. \q 원수가 헤스본에서 모압을 해치려고 악한 꾀를 낸다. \q "자, 모압을 없애 버리자. 다시는 나라가 되지 못하게 하자." \q 맛멘 성도 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 원수의 군인들이 칼을 들고 그 백성을 뒤쫓을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the praise of Moab: its renown, what it was praised for
decisions.reason: The word is used of the fame or glory of a city (49:25; 51:41). Moab's good name is over.

decisions.choice: in Heshbon they have planned: a play on the town's name
decisions.reason: Heshbon (Hebrew Cheshbon) sounds like the verb "plan" (chashevu): the town whose name means "reckoning" becomes the place where Moab's end is reckoned. Heshbon, Sihon's old city (Numbers 21:26), lay on Moab's northern edge; the enemy plots there, or takes it as a base. "They" are not named; the speech that follows shows that they are the invaders.

decisions.choice: Madmen, you will be silenced: a play on the town's name
alternatives: you will be utterly silenced (no town named)
decisions.reason: The name Madmen sounds like the verb "be silent" (damam), so the town is told it will live up to its name. The place is unknown elsewhere. Some suggest it is Dimon, a form of Dibon (Isaiah 15:9). The ancient Greek translation reads the words as a verb, "she will be utterly silenced", with no town named (a claim from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: come, let us cut her off: the words of the plotters
decisions.reason: The command and the "us" are the enemy's own words, quoted inside the oracle. "From being a nation" means that Moab will no longer exist as a people (compare Psalm 83:5).

decisions.choice: the enemy ... Enemy soldiers will chase its people with swords
decisions.reason: Readable names the plotters, which the Hebrew leaves unstated (m4), and explains "the sword will go after you".

decisions.choice: Hesbón ... Madmén
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on the names: in Heshbon (*ḥeshbon*) they "planned" (*ḥashvu*), and Madmen (*madmen*) "will be silenced" (*tiddommi*). Spanish cannot keep the wordplay.

decisions.choice: the town names kept, with no attempt to copy the Hebrew wordplay
decisions.reason: Heshbon sounds like "planned" and Madmen like "be silenced"; Swahili cannot keep the plays on the names, which the meaning decisions explain.

decisions.choice: the plays on Heshbon ("plan") and Madmen ("be silent") are not reproduced
decisions.reason: French cannot keep the sound-plays; the meaning decisions explain them, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "헤스본에서 ... 꾀했다" and "맛멘아 ... 잠잠해질 것이다", without imitating the wordplay
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions explain the plays on the names (Heshbon, "plan"; Madmen, "be silent"); Korean cannot carry them without changing the names.
