decisions.reason: Rock doves nest in cracks high in canyon walls (Song of Songs 2:14). The people must leave their towns and hide in the rocks like them (compare 4:29).

decisions.choice: the sides of the mouth of a chasm: the walls at the opening of a gorge
decisions.reason: The last word means a pit or deep hole; it is the "pit" of verses 43-44. Here it is a ravine or gorge, such as the canyons that cut through Moab.

decisions.choice: the cliffs beside
decisions.reason: Balanced says "cliffs" for the "sides" of the gorge.

source.text: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּאֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד גָּבְה֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ וְרֻ֥ם לִבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: We have heard [the] pride of Moab, proud very, his loftiness and his pride and his haughtiness and [the] height of his heart.

en.L: We have heard of the pride of Moab, very proud, \q its loftiness and its pride and its haughtiness and the height of its heart.
en.B: We have heard of Moab's pride, proud beyond measure: \q its lofty looks, its pride, its haughty airs, its heart held high.
en.R: We have heard how proud the people of Moab are. They are very proud. \q They look down on others. They think they are better than everyone, and their hearts are full of pride.

es.L: Hemos oído del orgullo de Moab, muy orgulloso, \q de su altivez y de su orgullo y de su arrogancia, y de la altanería de su corazón.
es.B: Hemos oído del orgullo de Moab, orgulloso sin medida: \q sus aires altivos, su orgullo, su arrogancia, su corazón engreído.
es.R: Hemos oído lo orgullosa que es la gente de Moab. Son muy orgullosos. \q Miran a los demás desde arriba. Se creen mejores que todos, y su corazón está lleno de orgullo.

fr.L: Nous avons entendu l’orgueil de Moab, très orgueilleux, \q sa hauteur, et son orgueil, et son arrogance, et l’élévation de son cœur.
fr.B: Nous avons entendu parler de l’orgueil de Moab, orgueilleux à l’extrême : \q ses airs hautains, son orgueil, son arrogance, son cœur plein de hauteur.
fr.R: Nous avons entendu combien les gens de Moab sont orgueilleux. Ils sont très fiers. \q Ils méprisent les autres. Ils se croient meilleurs que tout le monde, et leur cœur est plein d’orgueil.

sw.L: Tumesikia habari za kiburi cha Moabu, mwenye kiburi sana, \q kujikweza kwake na kiburi chake na majivuno yake na kujiinua kwa moyo wake.
sw.B: Tumesikia juu ya kiburi cha Moabu, kiburi kupita kiasi: \q macho yake ya juu, kiburi chake, majivuno yake, moyo wake uliojiinua.
sw.R: Tumesikia jinsi watu wa Moabu walivyo na kiburi. Wana kiburi kingi sana. \q Wanawadharau wengine. Wanajiona kuwa bora kuliko kila mtu, na mioyo yao imejaa kiburi.

vi.L: Chúng ta đã nghe về sự kiêu ngạo của Mô-áp, nó rất kiêu ngạo, \q về sự tự cao, sự kiêu căng, sự ngạo mạn và lòng tự đắc của nó.
vi.B: Chúng ta đã nghe về sự kiêu ngạo của Mô-áp, kiêu ngạo quá mức: \q dáng vẻ tự cao, sự kiêu căng, thái độ ngạo mạn và lòng tự đắc của nó.
vi.R: Chúng ta đã nghe dân Mô-áp kiêu ngạo thế nào. Họ rất kiêu ngạo. \q Họ khinh người khác. Họ tưởng mình hơn mọi người, và lòng họ đầy kiêu căng.

ko.L: 우리가 모압의 교만을 들었다. 그는 매우 교만하다. \q 그의 높음과 그의 교만과 그의 거만과 그의 마음의 높음을 [들었다].
ko.B: 우리는 모압이 교만하다는 말을 들었다. 그 교만이 하늘을 찌른다. \q 그 거만한 눈빛, 그 교만, 그 오만, 높아진 그 마음을 들었다.
ko.R: 우리는 모압 사람들이 얼마나 교만한지 들었다. 그들은 아주 교만하다. \q 그들은 다른 사람들을 업신여긴다. 그들은 자기들이 누구보다 낫다고 생각한다. 그들의 마음은 교만으로 가득하다.

decisions.choice: we have heard of the pride of Moab: Isaiah 16:6 taken up
decisions.reason: Verses 29-30 repeat Isaiah 16:6 with additions. Isaiah lists three words for pride (haughtiness, pride, arrogance); this verse has four, adding "loftiness" and "the height of its heart", and moves "arrogance" and the empty boasts into verse 30. Piling up words from the same roots makes Moab's pride overwhelming. Zephaniah 2:10 also names Moab's pride.

decisions.choice: the height of its heart: arrogance
decisions.reason: A heart that is "high" is a proud mind that looks down on others and on God (Deuteronomy 8:14; Ezekiel 31:10).

decisions.choice: we: the speaker and those with him
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 16:6, "we" may be the prophet with his people; in verse 30 the LORD speaks.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 16:6
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Isaiah 16:6 wording for the words the two verses share (Literal "haughtiness ... pride", Balanced "haughty airs ... pride", Readable "how proud ... think they are better than everyone") and adds the new words. As in Isaiah, Literal and Balanced say "its" for the Hebrew "his", meaning Moab.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 16:6
decisions.reason: Verses 29-38 echo Isaiah 15-16. The Spanish of those chapters is reused at each level where the Hebrew is the same: here the opening of Isaiah 16:6. Jeremiah adds "the height of his heart".

decisions.choice: the Swahili of Isaiah 16:6-11 and 15:2-6 where the Hebrew is the same (48:29-38)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's lament over Moab takes up Isaiah 15-16; where the Hebrew is the same the Swahili is the same ("Tumesikia habari za kiburi cha Moabu, mwenye kiburi sana", "ufidhuli", "majisifu", the vineyards, the shaved heads and beards, the roofs and squares), and it changes where Jeremiah changes the words.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 15-16 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Verses 29-38 take up Isaiah 16:6-11 and 15:2-6 (Moab's pride, the vine of Sibmah, the joy taken from the orchards, the cries from Heshbon to Jahaz, the shaved heads); the French keeps the wording of those verses at each level where the Hebrew is the same and changes only where it differs.

decisions.choice: Four words for pride kept at Literal and Balanced ("거만, 교만, 오만, 마음의 높음")
decisions.reason: As the English, which keeps the wording of Isaiah 16:6; Literal follows the Korean draft of Isaiah 16:6.

source.text: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה עֶבְרָת֖וֹ וְלֹא־כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖יו לֹא־כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I know, declares Yahweh, his arrogance, and not right; his empty boasts, not right have they done.

en.L: I myself know, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, its arrogance, and [it is] not right; \q its empty boasts, not right [is what] they have done.
en.B: I know its overbearing fury, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it is hollow. \q Its big talk comes to nothing, and nothing they do turns out right.
en.R: I know how arrogant and angry they are, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. But it is all empty. \q Their boasting is empty, and what they do comes to nothing.

es.L: Yo conozco, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, su arrogancia, y [que] no es recta; \q sus jactancias vanas no [son] rectas; no han hecho lo recto.
es.B: Yo conozco su furia desmedida, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; es hueca. \q Sus bravuconadas no valen nada, y nada de lo que hacen sale bien.
es.R: Yo sé lo arrogantes y llenos de ira que son, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Pero todo es vacío. \q Su jactancia está vacía, y lo que hacen no sirve para nada.

fr.L: Moi, je connais, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, son arrogance, et [ce n’est] pas juste ; \q ses vaines vantardises, [ce qu’]ils ont fait n’est pas juste.
fr.B: Je connais sa fureur arrogante, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; elle n’est que du vent. \q Ses grands discours ne mènent à rien, et rien de ce qu’ils font ne réussit.
fr.R: Je sais combien ils sont arrogants et coléreux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Mais tout cela est vide. \q Leurs vantardises sont vides, et ce qu’ils font ne mène à rien.

sw.L: Mimi nimejua, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ufidhuli wake, nao [si] sawa; \q majisifu yake, [walichotenda] si sawa.
sw.B: Ninaujua ufidhuli wake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; ni bure. \q Maneno yake makubwa ni bure, na hakuna wanalofanya linalofanikiwa.
sw.R: Ninajua jinsi walivyo na kiburi na hasira, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Lakini yote ni matupu. \q Majivuno yao ni matupu, na wanayoyafanya hayafikii kitu.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết sự xấc xược của nó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và [nó] chẳng ra gì; \q những lời khoác lác của nó, [những việc] chúng làm chẳng ra gì.
vi.B: Ta biết cơn giận dữ xấc xược của nó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; nó chỉ là rỗng tuếch. \q Những lời khoác lác của nó chẳng đi đến đâu, và chẳng việc gì chúng làm nên được.
vi.R: Ta biết chúng kiêu căng và giận dữ thế nào, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Nhưng tất cả đều rỗng tuếch. \q Lời khoe khoang của chúng là trống rỗng, và việc chúng làm chẳng ra gì.

ko.L: 나는 그의 오만을 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그것은 옳지 않다. \q 그의 헛된 자랑, 그들이 한 것은 옳지 않다.
ko.B: 나는 그의 오만한 분노를 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그것은 헛되다. \q 그의 큰소리는 아무것도 아니고, 그들이 하는 일은 하나도 제대로 되지 않는다.
ko.R: 나는 그들이 얼마나 교만하고 화를 잘 내는지 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그러나 그것은 다 헛되다. \q 그들의 자랑은 헛되고, 그들이 하는 일은 아무 소용이 없다.

decisions.choice: its arrogance, not right, its empty boasts: the end of Isaiah 16:6
decisions.reason: The words "its arrogance ... not right its empty boasts" are the last line of Isaiah 16:6. Here they are spoken by the LORD ("I know"), and a further "not right they have done" is added.

decisions.choice: arrogance: overflowing insolence or fury
decisions.reason: The word means pride that overflows its banks, and also rage (Isaiah 16:6, the note there).

decisions.choice: not right ... not right: Moab's boasting is empty and its deeds come to nothing
alternatives: what they have done is wrong
decisions.reason: "Not so" means not true or not sound. Moab's boasts are hollow, and its actions accomplish nothing, or are not as they should be.

decisions.choice: I know: God himself has seen Moab's pride
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is stated, which stresses the speaker: no boast is hidden from the LORD.

decisions.choice: overbearing fury ... big talk
decisions.reason: Balanced uses its wording from Isaiah 16:6 for the shared words.

decisions.choice: sus jactancias vanas (L); Sus bravuconadas no valen nada (B); Su jactancia está vacía (R)
decisions.reason: The words shared with Isaiah 16:6b keep the Spanish of that verse; Jeremiah adds "I know, declares the LORD" and "they have not done right".

source.text: עַל־כֵּן֙ עַל־מוֹאָ֣ב אֲיֵלִ֔יל וּלְמוֹאָ֥ב כֻּלֹּ֖ה אֶזְעָ֑ק אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר־חֶ֖רֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore over Moab I will wail, and for Moab, all of it, I will cry out; for [the] men of Kir-heres one moans.

en.L: Therefore over Moab I will wail, \q and for Moab, all of it, I will cry out; \q for the men of Kir-heres one moans.
en.B: So I wail over Moab; \q for all Moab I cry out; \q for the men of Kir-heres there is moaning.
en.R: So I cry over Moab. \q I cry out for all the people of Moab. \q People moan for the men of Kir-heres.

es.L: Por eso gemiré por Moab, \q y por todo Moab clamaré; \q por los hombres de Kir-heres se gime.
es.B: Por eso lloro a gritos por Moab; \q por todo Moab clamo; \q por los hombres de Kir-heres hay gemidos.
es.R: Por eso lloro por Moab. \q Lloro a gritos por toda la gente de Moab. \q La gente gime por los hombres de Kir-heres.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi sur Moab je me lamenterai, \q et pour Moab tout entier je crierai ; \q sur les hommes de Qir-Hérès on gémit.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je me lamente sur Moab ; \q pour Moab tout entier je pousse des cris ; \q sur les hommes de Qir-Hérès on gémit.
fr.R: Alors je pleure sur Moab. \q Je crie pour tous les habitants de Moab. \q On gémit sur les hommes de Qir-Hérès.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nitaomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu, \q na kwa ajili ya Moabu yote nitalia; \q kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-heresi mtu analia kwa huzuni.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ninaomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu; \q kwa ajili ya Moabu yote ninalia; \q kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-heresi kuna kuugua.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ninalia kwa ajili ya Moabu. \q Ninalia kwa sauti kwa ajili ya watu wote wa Moabu. \q Watu wanaugua kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-heresi.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ than van vì Mô-áp, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ kêu khóc vì cả Mô-áp; \q người ta rên rỉ vì dân Kiệt Hê-rết.
vi.B: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} than van vì Mô-áp; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} kêu khóc vì cả Mô-áp; \q có tiếng rên rỉ vì dân Kiệt Hê-rết.
vi.R: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khóc thương Mô-áp. \q Ta kêu khóc vì toàn dân Mô-áp. \q Người ta rên rỉ vì dân Kiệt Hê-rết.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 모압을 위하여 울부짖고, \q 모압 전체를 위하여 부르짖을 것이다. \q 길헤레스 사람들을 위하여 사람이 신음한다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 모압을 위하여 울부짖는다. \q 온 모압을 위하여 부르짖는다. \q 길헤레스 사람들을 위하여 신음하는 소리가 들린다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 모압 때문에 운다. \q 모압의 모든 백성 때문에 부르짖는다. \q 사람들이 길헤레스 사람들 때문에 신음한다.

decisions.choice: wail for Moab, moan for Kir-heres: Isaiah 16:7 taken up
decisions.reason: Isaiah 16:7 says "Moab will wail for Moab ... for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth you will moan". Here the speaker himself wails ("I will wail"), and the grief is for "the men of Kir-heres", not its raisin cakes. Kir-heres is the shorter form of Kir-hareseth, used in Isaiah 16:11 and in verse 36; it is Moab's capital, Kir of Moab (Isaiah 15:1; 2 Kings 3:25).

decisions.choice: I will wail ... I will cry out: the speaker mourns for Moab
decisions.reason: The speaker is not named. Just before, the LORD speaks (verse 30), and in verse 33 the LORD says "I have made the wine cease"; so the grief may be God's own, or the prophet's, as in Isaiah 15:5 and 16:9-11. The text does not settle it.

decisions.choice: one moans: the third person in the Hebrew text
alternatives: I moan for the men of Kir-heres
decisions.reason: The verb is "he moans", with no subject named, which may mean "one moans" or "there is moaning". With the change of one letter it would be "I moan", matching the first two lines; some ancient translations read it that way (a claim from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: there is moaning (B); People moan (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express the unnamed subject of "he moans" (m3) without choosing who it is.

decisions.choice: Kir-heres
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the form Kir-heres, as Isaiah 16:11, and the Spanish keeps the spelling of Isaiah 16:11. Isaiah 16:7 and 2 Kings 3:25 have Kir-hareset. Jeremiah says "I will wail ... the men of Kir-heres" where Isaiah 16:7 has "Moab will wail ... the raisin cakes of Kir-hareset", so only the name is shared.

decisions.choice: Ta (the speaker who wails, verses 31-36)
decisions.reason: The speaker who wails over Moab continues from "declares the LORD" in verse 30 and is the "I" who stops the wine in verse 33 and the offerings in verse 35, so Vietnamese says "Ta" through these verses. The English "I" does not show the choice.

source.text: מִבְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה־לָּךְ֙ הַגֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֨יִךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל־קֵיצֵ֥ךְ וְעַל־בְּצִירֵ֖ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥דנָפָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: More than [the] weeping of Jazer I weep for you, the vine of Sibmah; your shoots crossed over [the] sea, to [the] sea of Jazer they reached; upon your summer fruit and upon your vintage a destroyer has fallen.

en.L: More than the weeping of Jazer I weep for you, vine of Sibmah; \q your shoots crossed over [the] sea, \q to the sea of Jazer they reached; \q on your summer fruit and on your vintage the destroyer has fallen.
en.B: More than Jazer weeps, I weep for you, vine of Sibmah. \q Your runners crossed the sea \q and reached as far as the sea of Jazer. \q On your summer fruit and your grape harvest the destroyer has fallen.
en.R: Vine of Sibmah, I cry for you even more than the people of Jazer cry. \q Your branches spread across the Dead Sea. \q They reached as far as the sea of Jazer. \q But the destroyer has attacked your ripe fruit and your grapes.

es.L: Más que el llanto de Jazer lloro por ti, vid de Sibma; \q tus brotes pasaron más allá del mar, \q hasta el mar de Jazer llegaron; \q sobre tus frutos de verano y sobre tu vendimia ha caído el destructor.
es.B: Más de lo que llora Jazer, lloro yo por ti, vid de Sibma. \q Tus sarmientos cruzaron el mar \q y llegaron hasta el mar de Jazer. \q Sobre tus frutos maduros y tu vendimia ha caído el destructor.
es.R: Vid de Sibma, lloro por ti aún más de lo que llora la gente de Jazer. \q Tus ramas se extendían tanto que llegaban al otro lado del mar Muerto. \q Llegaban hasta el mar de Jazer. \q Pero el destructor ha atacado tu fruta madura y tus uvas.

fr.L: Plus que les pleurs de Yazer, je pleure sur toi, vigne de Sibma ; \q tes sarments ont passé [la] mer, \q jusqu’à la mer de Yazer ils sont parvenus ; \q sur tes fruits d’été et sur ta vendange le dévastateur s’est abattu.
fr.B: Plus que Yazer ne pleure, je pleure sur toi, vigne de Sibma. \q Tes sarments ont franchi la mer \q et sont allés jusqu’à la mer de Yazer. \q Sur tes fruits d’été et sur ta vendange, le dévastateur s’est abattu.
fr.R: Vigne de Sibma, je pleure sur toi plus encore que les gens de Yazer ne pleurent. \q Tes branches s’étendaient au-delà de la mer Morte. \q Elles allaient jusqu’à la mer de Yazer. \q Mais le dévastateur s’est jeté sur tes fruits mûrs et sur tes raisins.

sw.L: Kuliko kilio cha Yazeri ninakulilia, ewe mzabibu wa Sibma; \q matawi yako yalivuka bahari, \q yakafika mpaka bahari ya Yazeri; \q juu ya matunda yako ya kiangazi na juu ya mavuno yako ya zabibu mharibu ameanguka.
sw.B: Kuliko Yazeri anavyolia, ninakulilia, ewe mzabibu wa Sibma. \q Matawi yako yalivuka bahari \q na kufika mpaka bahari ya Yazeri. \q Juu ya matunda yako ya kiangazi na mavuno yako ya zabibu mharibu ameangukia.
sw.R: Ewe mzabibu wa Sibma, ninakulilia kuliko watu wa Yazeri wanavyolia. \q Matawi yako yalienea mpaka ng'ambo ya Bahari ya Chumvi. \q Yalifika mpaka bahari ya Yazeri. \q Lakini mharibu ameyashambulia matunda yako yaliyoiva na zabibu zako.

vi.L: Hơn cả sự khóc lóc của Gia-ê-xe, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khóc vì ngươi, hỡi cây nho Síp-ma; \q các nhánh ngươi đã vượt qua biển, \q vươn đến tận biển Gia-ê-xe; \q kẻ tàn phá đã giáng xuống trên trái mùa hạ và mùa nho của ngươi.
vi.B: Ta khóc vì ngươi, hỡi cây nho Síp-ma, còn hơn Gia-ê-xe khóc. \q Các nhánh ngươi đã vượt qua biển, \q vươn đến tận biển Gia-ê-xe. \q Kẻ tàn phá đã ập xuống trên trái mùa hạ và mùa hái nho của ngươi.
vi.R: Hỡi cây nho Síp-ma, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khóc vì ngươi còn hơn dân Gia-ê-xe khóc. \q Các nhánh ngươi đã lan rộng qua Biển Chết. \q Chúng vươn đến tận biển Gia-ê-xe. \q Nhưng kẻ hủy diệt đã tấn công trái chín và chùm nho của ngươi.

ko.L: 십마의 포도나무야, 야셀이 우는 것보다 더 내가 너를 위하여 운다. \q 네 덩굴이 바다를 건너, \q 야셀 바다까지 뻗었다. \q 네 여름 과일과 네 포도 수확 위에 파괴자가 덮쳤다.
ko.B: 십마의 포도나무야, 야셀이 우는 것보다 내가 너를 위하여 더 운다. \q 네 덩굴이 바다를 건너 \q 야셀 바다에까지 뻗어 나갔다. \q 그런데 네 여름 과일과 포도 수확 위에 파괴자가 덮쳤다.
ko.R: 십마의 포도나무야, 나는 야셀 사람들이 우는 것보다 더 너를 위하여 운다. \q 네 가지들은 사해 건너편까지 뻗어 나갔다. \q 야셀 바다에까지 이르렀다. \q 그러나 파괴하는 원수가 네 익은 과일과 포도를 덮쳤다.

decisions.choice: the vine of Sibmah: Isaiah 16:8-9 taken up
decisions.reason: The verse joins parts of Isaiah 16:8 and 16:9. Isaiah says "I weep with the weeping of Jazer"; this verse says "more than the weeping of Jazer" and speaks to the vine directly ("for you"). Isaiah's shoots "reached to Jazer ... crossed the sea"; here they "crossed the sea, reached to the sea of Jazer". Isaiah's last line has "the shout has fallen" on the harvest; here "the destroyer has fallen" on it, the reading Isaiah 16:9 notes as an alternative.

decisions.choice: the sea of Jazer: unknown, perhaps a copying slip
decisions.reason: No sea or lake is known at Jazer, a town north of Heshbon (Numbers 21:32). The word "sea" may have been written twice by a copyist, since it stands just before; Isaiah 16:8 has "to Jazer they reached". It may also name a pool or spring near the town.

decisions.choice: the sea, summer fruit and vintage
decisions.reason: The first sea is most likely the Dead Sea: Moab's vines, and their fame, spread far beyond its own land (Isaiah 16:8, note). Summer fruit is the ripe figs and grapes of late summer; the vintage is the grape harvest. The destroyer of verses 8 and 18 falls on it.

decisions.choice: I weep for you: grief for the enemy nation
decisions.reason: As in verse 31, the one who weeps may be the prophet or the LORD himself (verse 33).

decisions.choice: the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Readable names the sea, as in Isaiah 16:8 (m3).

decisions.choice: shoots / runners / branches; vintage / grape harvest / grapes
decisions.reason: Each level follows its wording in Isaiah 16:8-9 for the shoots; for the new word "vintage" Balanced says "grape harvest".

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 16:8-9
decisions.reason: The Spanish reuses the shared words of Isaiah 16:8-9 (brotes, más allá del mar, frutos de verano). It changes only where Jeremiah's Hebrew differs: "more than" the weeping of Jazer, the "sea of Jazer", "vintage" for "harvest", and the destroyer for the shout.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Chumvi" (R) for "the sea"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says the Dead Sea; "Bahari ya Chumvi", the Salt Sea, is the Old Testament's own name for it.

decisions.choice: "사해" (R) for "the sea"
decisions.reason: Readable names the sea as the English does.

source.text: וְנֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִ֛יל מִכַּרְמֶ֖ל וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְיַ֨יִן֙ מִיקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹֽא־יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And are gathered away gladness and joy from [the] fruitful land and from [the] land of Moab; and wine from [the] presses I have made to cease; not will tread [with] shouting; [the] shouting [is] not shouting.

en.L: And gladness and joy are gathered away from the fruitful land and from the land of Moab; \q and wine from the presses I have made to cease; \q no one treads with shouting; \q the shouting [is] no shouting.
en.B: Gladness and delight are gathered up and gone from the garden land, from the land of Moab. \q I have stopped the wine from flowing from the presses; \q no one treads the grapes with the harvest shout. \q The shouting is no shout of joy.
en.R: There is no more joy or gladness in the orchards or anywhere in Moab. \q I have stopped the wine from flowing from the winepresses. \q No one crushes the grapes with happy shouts. \q The shouting people hear is not a happy shout.

es.L: Y se han retirado la alegría y el regocijo del campo fértil y de la tierra de Moab; \q y el vino de los lagares he hecho cesar; \q no pisa [el pisador] con grito de júbilo; \q el grito no [es] grito [de júbilo].
es.B: La alegría y el gozo se han ido de la tierra de huertos, de la tierra de Moab. \q He hecho que el vino deje de correr de los lagares; \q nadie pisa la uva con gritos de vendimia. \q Los gritos ya no son de alegría.
es.R: Ya no hay alegría ni gozo en los huertos ni en ninguna parte de Moab. \q He hecho que el vino deje de salir de los lagares. \q Ya nadie pisa uvas con gritos de alegría. \q Los gritos que se oyen no son de alegría.

fr.L: Et la joie et l’allégresse sont enlevées du verger et du pays de Moab ; \q et le vin des pressoirs, je l’ai fait cesser ; \q on ne foule plus avec des cris de joie ; \q le cri n’est pas un cri [de joie].
fr.B: La joie et l’allégresse ont été ramassées et emportées loin des vergers et du pays de Moab. \q J’ai fait tarir le vin des pressoirs ; \q personne ne foule plus le raisin en poussant le cri des vendanges. \q Le cri qu’on entend n’est pas un cri de joie.
fr.R: Il n’y a plus de joie ni de gaieté dans les vergers, ni nulle part en Moab. \q J’ai arrêté le vin qui coulait des pressoirs. \q Personne ne foule plus le raisin avec des cris de joie. \q Les cris qu’on entend ne sont pas des cris de joie.

sw.L: Na furaha na shangwe zimeondolewa katika shamba lenye rutuba na katika nchi ya Moabu; \q nami nimeikomesha divai katika mashinikizo; \q hakuna anayekanyaga kwa kelele za shangwe; \q kelele [si] kelele za shangwe.
sw.B: Furaha na shangwe zimekusanywa na kutoweka katika nchi ya bustani, katika nchi ya Moabu. \q Nimeikomesha divai isitiririke kutoka kwenye mashinikizo; \q hakuna anayekanyaga zabibu kwa kelele za mavuno. \q Kelele zilizopo si kelele za furaha.
sw.R: Hakuna tena furaha wala shangwe katika bustani za matunda wala mahali popote Moabu. \q Nimeikomesha divai isitoke katika mashinikizo. \q Hakuna anayekanyaga zabibu kwa kelele za furaha. \q Kelele ambazo watu wanasikia si kelele za furaha.

vi.L: Sự vui mừng và hân hoan đã bị cất khỏi đồng ruộng phì nhiêu và khỏi xứ Mô-áp; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho rượu thôi chảy từ các bồn ép; \q không ai đạp nho với tiếng reo hò; \q tiếng reo hò không phải là tiếng reo hò.
vi.B: Niềm vui và sự hân hoan đã bị cất khỏi miền vườn tược và khỏi xứ Mô-áp. \q Ta đã làm cho rượu thôi chảy ra từ các bồn ép; \q không ai còn đạp nho với tiếng hò reo mùa gặt. \q Tiếng hò reo kia không phải là tiếng reo vui.
vi.R: Không còn niềm vui hay sự hân hoan trong các vườn cây hay bất cứ nơi nào ở Mô-áp. \q Ta đã làm cho rượu thôi chảy ra từ các bồn ép nho. \q Không ai còn đạp nho với tiếng reo vui. \q Tiếng la hét người ta nghe không phải là tiếng reo vui.

ko.L: 그리고 기쁨과 즐거움이 기름진 밭과 모압 땅에서 거두어졌다. \q 내가 포도주 틀에서 포도주가 그치게 했다. \q 아무도 환호하며 밟지 않는다. \q 그 환호는 환호가 아니다.
ko.B: 기름진 동산, 곧 모압 땅에서 기쁨과 즐거움이 거두어져 사라졌다. \q 내가 포도주 틀에서 포도주가 흘러나오지 않게 했다. \q 아무도 수확의 환호를 외치며 포도를 밟지 않는다. \q 그 외침은 기쁨의 환호가 아니다.
ko.R: 과수원에도, 모압 어디에도 더 이상 기쁨도 즐거움도 없다. \q 내가 포도주 틀에서 포도주가 흘러나오지 않게 했다. \q 아무도 즐겁게 소리치며 포도를 밟지 않는다. \q 사람들이 듣는 외침은 기쁜 외침이 아니다.

decisions.choice: gladness and joy gathered away: Isaiah 16:10 taken up
decisions.reason: The verse follows Isaiah 16:10 with changes: it adds "and from the land of Moab", leaves out the line about singing in the vineyards, and says "wine from the presses I have made to cease" where Isaiah has "the treader does not tread wine in the presses ... the shout I have made to cease". It ends with a new line: "the shouting is no shouting".

decisions.choice: the shouting is no shouting: the harvest cry has become a battle cry
decisions.reason: The word is the rhythmic shout of the grape treaders (25:30). The shout now heard in Moab is not the joy of harvest but the war cry of the enemy (compare 51:14, where the same word is the shout of victors).

decisions.choice: the fruitful land: orchard and garden country
decisions.reason: The word is the same as the name Carmel, but here it means fertile land with fruit trees and vines, as in Isaiah 16:10.

decisions.choice: I have made to cease: God speaks
decisions.reason: The LORD himself has ended the joy of the harvest, as in Isaiah 16:10. Verse 35 continues, "I will make an end".

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 16:10
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Isaiah 16:10 wording for the shared lines (Literal "gathered away from the fruitful land", Balanced "gathered up and gone from the garden land", Readable "no more joy or gladness in the orchards").

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 16:10
decisions.reason: The first line keeps the Spanish of Isaiah 16:10 at each level and adds "the land of Moab", as Jeremiah's Hebrew does. The rest is worded differently in the Hebrew and so differs.

decisions.choice: "환호" (L), "환호 ... 기쁨의 환호" (B), "외침 ... 기쁜 외침" (R)
decisions.reason: The play on *hedad*, the harvest shout that turns into a battle cry (meaning decision), kept by repeating one word.

source.text: מִזַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד־אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה עַד־יַ֨הַץ֙ נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם מִצֹּ֨עַר֙ עַד־חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם־מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים לִמְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יִהְיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] cry of Heshbon to Elealeh, to Jahaz they have given their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, Eglath-shelishiyah; for also [the] waters of Nimrim desolations will become.

en.L: From the cry of Heshbon as far as Elealeh, as far as Jahaz, they have raised their voice, \q from Zoar as far as Horonaim, Eglath-shelishiyah; \q for even the waters of Nimrim will become desolations.
en.B: The cry of Heshbon is heard in Elealeh; they raise their voices as far as Jahaz, \q from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah. \q Even the waters of Nimrim will turn to waste ground.
en.R: The people of Heshbon cry out, and their cries are heard in Elealeh and as far away as Jahaz. \q People cry from Zoar all the way to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah. \q Even the streams at Nimrim will become dry land.

es.L: Desde el clamor de Hesbón hasta Eleale, hasta Jahaz dieron su voz, \q desde Zoar hasta Horonaim, Eglat-selisiya; \q porque también las aguas de Nimrim serán desolaciones.
es.B: El clamor de Hesbón se oye en Eleale; levantan la voz hasta Jahaz, \q desde Zoar hasta Horonaim y Eglat-selisiya. \q Hasta las aguas de Nimrim se convertirán en tierra baldía.
es.R: La gente de Hesbón grita, y sus gritos se oyen en Eleale y hasta Jahaz. \q La gente grita desde Zoar hasta Horonaim y Eglat-selisiya. \q Hasta los arroyos de Nimrim se convertirán en tierra seca.

fr.L: Depuis le cri de Heshbon jusqu’à Élealé, jusqu’à Yahats, ils ont fait entendre leur voix, \q depuis Tsoar jusqu’à Horonaïm, Églath-Shelishiya ; \q car même les eaux de Nimrim deviendront des désolations.
fr.B: Le cri de Heshbon s’entend jusqu’à Élealé ; jusqu’à Yahats on élève la voix, \q de Tsoar jusqu’à Horonaïm et Églath-Shelishiya. \q Même les eaux de Nimrim deviendront une terre désolée.
fr.R: Les habitants de Heshbon crient, et on entend leurs cris jusqu’à Élealé et même jusqu’à Yahats. \q On crie depuis Tsoar jusqu’à Horonaïm et Églath-Shelishiya. \q Même les ruisseaux de Nimrim deviendront une terre sèche.

sw.L: Kutoka kilio cha Heshboni mpaka Eleale, mpaka Yahasi wamepaza sauti yao, \q kutoka Soari mpaka Horonaimu, Eglath-shelishiya; \q kwa maana hata maji ya Nimrimu yatakuwa ukiwa.
sw.B: Kilio cha Heshboni kinasikika Eleale; wanapaza sauti zao mpaka Yahasi, \q kutoka Soari mpaka Horonaimu na Eglath-shelishiya. \q Hata maji ya Nimrimu yatakuwa nchi ya ukiwa.
sw.R: Watu wa Heshboni wanalia, na vilio vyao vinasikika Eleale na mbali mpaka Yahasi. \q Watu wanalia kutoka Soari mpaka Horonaimu na Eglath-shelishiya. \q Hata vijito vya Nimrimu vitakuwa nchi kavu.

vi.L: Từ tiếng kêu la của Hết-bôn đến tận Ê-lê-a-lê, đến tận Gia-hác, chúng đã cất tiếng, \q từ Xô-a đến tận Hô-rô-na-im, Éc-lát Sê-li-si-gia; \q vì ngay cả các dòng nước Nim-rim cũng sẽ thành hoang vu.
vi.B: Tiếng kêu la của Hết-bôn vang đến Ê-lê-a-lê; chúng cất tiếng đến tận Gia-hác, \q từ Xô-a đến Hô-rô-na-im và Éc-lát Sê-li-si-gia. \q Ngay cả các dòng nước Nim-rim cũng sẽ thành đất hoang.
vi.R: Dân Hết-bôn kêu la, và tiếng kêu của họ vang đến Ê-lê-a-lê và xa đến tận Gia-hác. \q Người ta kêu khóc từ Xô-a cho đến Hô-rô-na-im và Éc-lát Sê-li-si-gia. \q Ngay cả các dòng suối ở Nim-rim cũng sẽ khô cạn.

ko.L: 헤스본의 부르짖음이 엘르알레까지, 야하스까지 그들이 소리를 높였다. \q 소알에서 호로나임과 에글랏 슬리시야까지 [소리를 높였다]. \q 니므림의 물들도 황무지가 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 헤스본의 부르짖음이 엘르알레에까지 들리고, 그들이 야하스에까지 소리를 높인다. \q 소알에서 호로나임과 에글랏 슬리시야에까지 부르짖는다. \q 니므림의 물마저 황무지가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 헤스본 사람들이 부르짖는다. 그 소리가 엘르알레와 멀리 야하스에까지 들린다. \q 소알에서 호로나임과 에글랏 슬리시야에 이르기까지 사람들이 부르짖는다. \q 니므림의 시냇물까지 말라 버릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: Heshbon to Jahaz, Zoar, Eglath-shelishiyah, Nimrim: Isaiah 15:4-6 taken up
decisions.reason: The verse gathers phrases from Isaiah 15:4 ("Heshbon cries out, and Elealeh; as far as Jahaz their voice is heard"), 15:5 ("as far as Zoar, Eglath-shelishiyah") and 15:6 ("the waters of Nimrim are desolations"). It adds Horonaim from 15:5 and has "they have given their voice" for "their voice is heard", and "will become" for "are". The places run from Heshbon in the north to Zoar in the far south: the cry fills the land.

decisions.choice: from the cry of Heshbon ... they have raised their voice
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is compressed: the cry starts at Heshbon and is taken up town after town. The first phrase may also mean "because of the cry of Heshbon".

decisions.choice: Eglath-shelishiyah, Nimrim
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 15:5-6: Eglath-shelishiyah is otherwise unknown (the name may mean "the third Eglath"), and the waters of Nimrim are most likely a stream in the south of Moab.

decisions.choice: is heard
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies a verb for the first phrase, as Isaiah 15:4 has "is heard".

decisions.choice: waste ground / dry land
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep their Isaiah 15:6 wording.

decisions.choice: Jahaz; las aguas de Nimrim ... desolaciones / tierra baldía / tierra seca
decisions.reason: The verse gathers lines from Isaiah 15:4-6, and their Spanish is kept at each level. The town is Jahaz, as in Isaiah 15:4, where the Hebrew has that form.

source.text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י לְמוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּמַקְטִ֖יר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make cease for Moab, declares Yahweh, [one] offering up [at the] high place and burning incense to his gods.

en.L: And I will make an end in Moab, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q of the one who offers up [sacrifice at] the high place \q and burns incense to {{gender:their|his}} gods.
en.B: I will put an end in Moab, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q to anyone who goes up to offer sacrifice at the high place \q and burns incense to {{gender:their|his}} gods.
en.R: I will stop the people of Moab, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q from offering sacrifices at their hilltop shrines \q and burning incense to their gods.

es.L: Y haré cesar en Moab, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q al que ofrece [sacrificio en] el lugar alto \q y quema incienso a sus dioses.
es.B: Acabaré en Moab, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q con quien sube a ofrecer sacrificios en el lugar alto \q y quema incienso a sus dioses.
es.R: Haré que la gente de Moab deje de ofrecer sacrificios, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en sus santuarios sobre las colinas \q y de quemar incienso a sus dioses.

fr.L: Et je ferai disparaître de Moab, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q celui qui monte [offrir] au haut lieu \q et qui brûle de l’encens à ses dieux.
fr.B: Je mettrai fin en Moab, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q à celui qui monte offrir des sacrifices sur le haut lieu \q et qui brûle de l’encens à ses dieux.
fr.R: J’empêcherai les gens de Moab, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q d’offrir des sacrifices sur leurs lieux de culte en haut des collines \q et de brûler de l’encens à leurs dieux.

sw.L: Nami nitakomesha katika Moabu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q yeye atoaye [dhabihu] mahali pa juu \q na kuifukizia uvumba miungu yake.
sw.B: Nitamkomesha katika Moabu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kila mtu anayepanda kutoa dhabihu mahali pa juu \q na kuifukizia uvumba miungu yake.
sw.R: Nitawazuia watu wa Moabu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wasitoe dhabihu katika patakatifu pao pa kilimani \q na kuifukizia uvumba miungu yao.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho dứt khỏi Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q kẻ dâng [tế lễ trên] nơi cao \q và đốt hương cho các thần của mình.
vi.B: Ta sẽ chấm dứt tại Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q kẻ đi lên dâng tế lễ trên nơi cao \q và đốt hương cho các thần của mình.
vi.R: Ta sẽ không để dân Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q dâng tế lễ tại các miếu trên đồi cao \q và đốt hương cho các thần của chúng nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 모압에서 \q 산당에서 [제사를] 바치는 자와 \q 자기 신들에게 분향하는 자를 그치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 모압에서 \q 산당에 올라가 제사를 드리는 자와 \q 자기 신들에게 분향하는 자를 없애겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 나는 모압 백성이 \q 산꼭대기 제단에서 제물을 바치고 \q 자기 신들에게 향을 피우는 일을 그치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: the high place: a hilltop shrine
decisions.reason: High places were open-air shrines on hills where sacrifices and incense were offered (7:31; Isaiah 15:2; 16:12). Moab weeps and prays at its high place in Isaiah 16:12, to no effect; here God ends that worship altogether.

decisions.choice: the one who offers ... to his gods: every worshiper
decisions.reason: The singular participles mean anyone who worships there. "His gods" may also be "his god", Chemosh, since the word for God is plural in form.

decisions.choice: their, with "his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The worshiper stands for anyone, man or woman, so the pronoun follows the gender setting.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines
decisions.reason: Readable explains "high place" (m1) and speaks of Moab's people as a whole.

decisions.choice: sus dioses
decisions.reason: Spanish "sus" serves for both "his" and "their", so the English gender setting needs no span here.

decisions.choice: "mahali pa juu" (L, B); "patakatifu pa kilimani" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for the high places in Kings; "miungu yake" needs no gender span, since the Swahili possessive has no gender.

decisions.choice: "celui qui ... à ses dieux", with no gender span
decisions.reason: French "celui qui" already means anyone, and "ses" agrees with "dieux", so the wording is the same for both English settings.

decisions.choice: các thần của mình
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "mình" refers back to whoever offers, man or woman, so no gender span is needed where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "산당" (L, B); "산꼭대기 제단" (R) for the high place
decisions.reason: The Kings tables' forms.

decisions.choice: "자기" with no real gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" refers to any person, man or woman, so the English setting has nothing to change here.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤י לְמוֹאָב֙ כַּחֲלִלִ֣ים יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְלִבִּי֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר־חֶ֔רֶשׂ כַּחֲלִילִ֖ים יֶהֱמֶ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore my heart for Moab like flutes moans, and my heart for [the] men of Kir-heres like flutes moans; therefore [the] abundance [that] it gained has perished.

en.L: Therefore my heart moans for Moab like flutes, \q and my heart moans for the men of Kir-heres like flutes; \q therefore the abundance [that] it has gained has perished.
en.B: So my heart moans for Moab like a flute; \q my heart moans like a flute for the men of Kir-heres. \q So the riches they had amassed are lost.
en.R: My heart is sad for Moab. It cries like the sad music of a flute. \q My heart mourns like a flute for the men of Kir-heres. \q All the riches they had saved are gone.

es.L: Por eso mi corazón gime por Moab como flautas, \q y mi corazón gime como flautas por los hombres de Kir-heres; \q por eso la abundancia [que] ha adquirido ha perecido.
es.B: Por eso mi corazón gime por Moab como una flauta; \q mi corazón gime como una flauta por los hombres de Kir-heres. \q Por eso se han perdido las riquezas que habían juntado.
es.R: Mi corazón está triste por Moab. Llora como la música triste de una flauta. \q Mi corazón está de luto como una flauta por los hombres de Kir-heres. \q Todo lo que habían ahorrado se ha perdido.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi mon cœur gémit pour Moab comme des flûtes, \q et mon cœur gémit pour les hommes de Qir-Hérès comme des flûtes ; \q c’est pourquoi l’abondance qu’il a acquise a péri.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi mon cœur gémit pour Moab comme une flûte ; \q mon cœur gémit comme une flûte pour les hommes de Qir-Hérès. \q Aussi les richesses qu’ils avaient amassées sont perdues.
fr.R: Mon cœur est triste pour Moab. Il pleure comme la musique triste d’une flûte. \q Mon cœur est en deuil comme une flûte pour les hommes de Qir-Hérès. \q Toutes les richesses qu’ils avaient mises de côté ont disparu.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unaugua kwa ajili ya Moabu kama filimbi, \q na moyo wangu unaugua kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-heresi kama filimbi; \q kwa hiyo wingi [wa mali] waliojipatia umepotea.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unaomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu kama filimbi; \q moyo wangu unaomboleza kama filimbi kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-heresi. \q Kwa hiyo utajiri walioukusanya umepotea.
sw.R: Moyo wangu una huzuni kwa ajili ya Moabu. Unalia kama muziki wa huzuni wa filimbi. \q Moyo wangu unaomboleza kama filimbi kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-heresi. \q Utajiri wote walioweka akiba umetoweka.

vi.L: Vì vậy lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rên rỉ vì Mô-áp như tiếng sáo, \q lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rên rỉ như tiếng sáo vì dân Kiệt Hê-rết; \q vì vậy của dư dật nó đã kiếm được đã mất hết.
vi.B: Vì thế lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rên rỉ vì Mô-áp như tiếng sáo; \q lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rên rỉ như tiếng sáo vì dân Kiệt Hê-rết. \q Vì thế của cải chúng tích lũy đã tiêu tan.
vi.R: Lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} buồn bã vì Mô-áp. Lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khóc như tiếng sáo buồn. \q Lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thương khóc như tiếng sáo vì dân Kiệt Hê-rết. \q Mọi của cải họ đã dành dụm đều mất hết.

ko.L: 그러므로 내 마음이 모압을 위하여 피리처럼 신음하고, \q 내 마음이 길헤레스 사람들을 위하여 피리처럼 신음한다. \q 그러므로 그가 얻은 풍부한 재물이 없어졌다.
ko.B: 그래서 내 마음이 모압을 위하여 피리처럼 구슬피 운다. \q 길헤레스 사람들을 위하여 내 마음이 피리처럼 운다. \q 그들이 모은 재물이 다 없어졌기 때문이다.
ko.R: 내 마음이 모압 때문에 슬프다. 피리의 구슬픈 가락처럼 운다. \q 내 마음이 길헤레스 사람들 때문에 피리처럼 슬피 운다. \q 그들이 모아 둔 재물이 모두 사라졌다.

decisions.choice: my heart moans like flutes: Isaiah 16:11 and 15:7 taken up
decisions.reason: Isaiah 16:11 has "my inward parts sound like a lyre for Moab, and my inner being for Kir-heres". Here the speaker's heart moans "like flutes", and the grief is for "the men of" Kir-heres. The last line takes up Isaiah 15:7, "the abundance it has gained", and adds "has perished".

decisions.choice: flutes: the pipes played at funerals
decisions.reason: The flute or reed pipe was played at feasts (Isaiah 5:12) and also at mourning (Matthew 9:23). Its low, wailing sound pictures the speaker's grief.

decisions.choice: the abundance it has gained has perished: the reason for the grief
decisions.reason: "It" is Moab; the verb "perished" is plural, for its many riches. Their wealth and stores are lost (compare verse 7).

decisions.choice: the riches they had amassed / All the riches they had saved
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep their Isaiah 15:7 wording for the shared phrase.

decisions.choice: la abundancia [que] ha adquirido (L); las riquezas que habían juntado (B); Todo lo que habían ahorrado (R)
decisions.reason: The last line shares its words with Isaiah 15:7, and their Spanish is kept. Jeremiah's "flutes" differs from the lyre of Isaiah 16:11.

source.text: כִּ֤י כָל־רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְכָל־זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל־יָדַ֨יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְעַל־מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק׃

records.literal_gloss: For every head [is] baldness, and every beard [is] cut short; upon all hands [are] gashes, and upon [the] loins sackcloth.

en.L: For every head [is] baldness, and every beard [is] cut short; \q on all hands [are] gashes, and on [the] loins sackcloth.
en.B: Every head is bald, every beard clipped short; \q there are gashes on every hand, and sackcloth around the waist.
en.R: All of them have shaved their heads and cut off their beards to show their grief. \q They have cut their hands, and they wear rough sackcloth around their waists.

es.L: Porque toda cabeza [tiene] calvicie, y toda barba [está] rapada; \q sobre todas las manos [hay] cortes, y sobre los lomos cilicio.
es.B: Todas las cabezas están rapadas, todas las barbas cortadas; \q hay cortes en todas las manos, y cilicio alrededor de la cintura.
es.R: Todos se han rapado la cabeza y se han cortado la barba en señal de dolor. \q Se han hecho cortes en las manos, y llevan ropa áspera de luto en la cintura.

fr.L: Car toute tête [est] chauve, et toute barbe [est] rasée ; \q sur toutes les mains [il y a] des incisions, et sur les reins un sac.
fr.B: Toutes les têtes sont rasées, toutes les barbes coupées ; \q il y a des incisions sur toutes les mains, et un sac autour des reins.
fr.R: Tous se sont rasé la tête et coupé la barbe pour montrer leur douleur. \q Ils se sont fait des entailles sur les mains, et ils portent un vêtement de toile grossière autour de la taille.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila kichwa [ni] upara, na kila ndevu [zimenyolewa]; \q juu ya mikono yote [kuna] michoro ya kujikata, na viunoni magunia.
sw.B: Kila kichwa ni kipara, kila ndevu zimekatwa; \q kuna majeraha ya kujikata katika kila mkono, na magunia viunoni.
sw.R: Wote wamenyoa vichwa vyao na kukata ndevu zao kuonyesha huzuni yao. \q Wamejikata mikono yao, nao wamevaa magunia magumu viunoni mwao.

vi.L: Vì mọi đầu [đều] trọc, mọi râu [đều] bị cắt ngắn; \q trên mọi bàn tay [có] vết rạch, và quanh lưng [có] vải thô.
vi.B: Mọi đầu đều cạo trọc, mọi chòm râu đều bị cắt ngắn; \q mọi bàn tay đều có vết rạch, và quanh lưng đều quấn vải thô.
vi.R: Mọi người đều cạo đầu và cắt râu để tỏ lòng thương tiếc. \q Họ rạch tay mình và quấn vải thô quanh lưng.

ko.L: 참으로 모든 머리가 대머리가 되고, 모든 수염이 잘렸다. \q 모든 손에 상처가 [있고], 허리에는 굵은 베가 [있다].
ko.B: 모두가 머리를 밀고, 모두가 수염을 깎았다. \q 모든 손에는 상처가 있고, 허리에는 굵은 베옷을 둘렀다.
ko.R: 그들은 모두 슬픔을 나타내려고 머리를 밀고 수염을 깎았다. \q 손에 상처를 내고, 허리에 거친 베옷을 둘렀다.

decisions.choice: every head bald, every beard cut: Isaiah 15:2-3 taken up
decisions.reason: The first line is Isaiah 15:2 ("on all its heads is baldness, every beard is cut short") with "every head" for "all its heads". The sackcloth comes from Isaiah 15:3; the gashes on the hands are new.

decisions.choice: shaved heads, cut beards, gashes, sackcloth: signs of mourning
decisions.reason: Mourners shaved the head, cut the beard, gashed their skin and wore rough sackcloth (16:6; 41:5; 47:5). Israel's law forbade cutting the body for the dead (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1), but Moab mourned in this way.

decisions.choice: to show their grief ... rough
decisions.reason: Readable keeps its Isaiah 15:2-3 wording and says why they do this (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 15:2
decisions.reason: The first line keeps the Spanish of Isaiah 15:2 at each level, and sackcloth is "cilicio" (L, B) and "ropa áspera de luto" (R), as in Isaiah 15:3.

source.text: עַ֣ל כָּל־גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֖יהָ כֻּלֹּ֣ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת־מוֹאָ֗ב כִּכְלִ֛י אֵֽין־חֵ֥פֶץ בּ֖וֹ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Upon all [the] roofs of Moab and in its squares, all of it [is] lamentation; for I have broken Moab like a vessel [in which there is] no delight, declares Yahweh.

en.L: On all the roofs of Moab and in its squares, all of it [is] lamentation; \q for I have broken Moab like a vessel no one delights in, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: On all the roofs of Moab and in its open squares there is nothing but mourning, \q for I have smashed Moab like a jar that no one wants, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: On every flat roof in Moab and in its town squares there is only weeping. \q I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants anymore, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Sobre todos los terrados de Moab y en sus plazas, todo él [es] lamento; \q porque he quebrado a Moab como a vasija que no agrada, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: En todos los terrados de Moab y en sus plazas no hay más que llanto, \q porque he hecho pedazos a Moab como a un cántaro que nadie quiere, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: En todos los techos planos de Moab y en sus plazas solo hay llanto. \q He roto a Moab como a un cántaro que ya nadie quiere, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Sur tous les toits de Moab et dans ses places, tout [n’est que] lamentation ; \q car j’ai brisé Moab comme un vase dont on ne veut pas, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Sur tous les toits de Moab et sur ses places, il n’y a que des lamentations, \q car j’ai brisé Moab comme une jarre dont personne ne veut, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Sur tous les toits plats de Moab et sur les places des villes, on n’entend que des pleurs. \q J’ai brisé Moab comme une jarre dont personne ne veut plus, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Juu ya dari zote za Moabu na katika viwanja vyake, kote [ni] maombolezo; \q kwa maana nimeivunja Moabu kama chombo kisichopendezwa na mtu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Juu ya dari zote za Moabu na katika viwanja vyake vya wazi hakuna kitu ila maombolezo, \q kwa maana nimeivunjavunja Moabu kama mtungi usiotakiwa na mtu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Juu ya kila dari ya Moabu na katika viwanja vya miji yake kuna kilio tu. \q Nimeivunja Moabu kama mtungi ambao hakuna mtu anayeutaka tena, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Trên mọi mái nhà của Mô-áp và tại các quảng trường, khắp nơi [đều có] tiếng than khóc; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đập vỡ Mô-áp như cái bình không ai ưa thích, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Trên mọi mái nhà của Mô-áp và tại các quảng trường chỉ còn tiếng khóc than, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đập vỡ Mô-áp như một cái vò chẳng ai cần đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Trên mọi mái nhà bằng ở Mô-áp và tại các quảng trường chỉ có tiếng khóc lóc. \q Ta đã đập vỡ Mô-áp như cái vò không ai muốn dùng nữa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 모압의 모든 지붕 위와 그 광장들에서, 모두가 애곡이다. \q 내가 아무도 좋아하지 않는 그릇처럼 모압을 깨뜨렸기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 모압의 모든 지붕 위와 광장마다 슬피 우는 소리뿐이다. \q 내가 아무도 원하지 않는 항아리처럼 모압을 깨뜨려 버렸기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 모압의 모든 평평한 지붕 위와 성읍 광장마다 울음소리뿐이다. \q 내가 아무도 더 이상 원하지 않는 항아리처럼 모압을 깨뜨렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: on its roofs and in its squares: Isaiah 15:3 taken up
decisions.reason: Isaiah 15:3 has "on its roofs and in its squares all of it wails"; here "all of it is lamentation". Houses had flat roofs where people could lament in public.

decisions.choice: like a vessel no one delights in: thrown away as worthless
decisions.reason: The same phrase is said of King Coniah in 22:28 (compare Hosea 8:8). A clay jar no one wants is smashed and thrown out (19:11). The LORD has broken Moab.

decisions.choice: the wording of 22:28
decisions.reason: Each level uses its wording from 22:28 for the shared phrase.

decisions.choice: terrados ... plazas (Isaiah 15:3)
decisions.reason: The first line keeps the words of Isaiah 15:3; Jeremiah adds the broken vessel.

source.text: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֨תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ הִפְנָה־עֹ֥רֶף מוֹאָ֖ב בּ֑וֹשׁ וְהָיָ֥ה מוֹאָ֛ב לִשְׂחֹ֥ק וְלִמְחִתָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: How it is shattered! They wail! How has turned [the] back Moab in shame! And will become Moab a laughingstock and a terror to all around him.

en.L: How it is shattered! They wail! \q How Moab has turned [its] back in shame! \q And Moab will become a laughingstock and a horror to all around him.
en.B: How shattered it is! How they wail! \q How Moab has turned its back in shame! \q Moab will become something to laugh at and a thing of horror to all its neighbors.
en.R: Moab is broken! Hear how its people wail! \q Moab has turned and run away in shame. \q All the nations around it will laugh at it and be horrified by what has happened to it.

es.L: ¡Cómo ha sido quebrantado! ¡Gimen! \q ¡Cómo ha vuelto Moab la espalda avergonzado! \q Y Moab será objeto de burla y espanto para todos los que están a su alrededor.
es.B: ¡Qué destrozado está! ¡Cómo gimen! \q ¡Cómo ha vuelto Moab la espalda avergonzado! \q Moab será motivo de risa y de horror para todos sus vecinos.
es.R: ¡Moab está destrozado! ¡{{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} cómo llora su gente! \q Moab ha dado la vuelta y ha huido avergonzado. \q Todas las naciones que lo rodean se reirán de él y se horrorizarán de lo que le ha pasado.

fr.L: Comme il est brisé ! Ils se lamentent ! \q Comme Moab a tourné le dos avec honte ! \q Et Moab deviendra un objet de risée et d’horreur pour tous ceux qui l’entourent.
fr.B: Comme il est brisé ! Comme ils se lamentent ! \q Comme Moab a tourné le dos, couvert de honte ! \q Moab deviendra la risée de tous ses voisins et un objet d’horreur pour eux.
fr.R: Moab est brisé ! Écoutez les lamentations de ses habitants ! \q Moab a fait demi-tour et s’est enfui, couvert de honte. \q Toutes les nations autour de lui se moqueront de lui et seront horrifiées par ce qui lui est arrivé.

sw.L: Jinsi ilivyovunjwa! Wanapiga yowe! \q Jinsi Moabu ilivyogeuza mgongo kwa aibu! \q Naye Moabu atakuwa kitu cha kuchekwa na kitisho kwa wote wanaomzunguka.
sw.B: Jinsi ilivyovunjwavunjwa! Jinsi wanavyopiga yowe! \q Jinsi Moabu ilivyogeuka nyuma kwa aibu! \q Moabu itakuwa kitu cha kudhihakiwa na cha kutisha kwa jirani zake wote.
sw.R: Moabu imevunjika! Sikieni watu wake wanavyopiga yowe! \q Moabu imegeuka na kukimbia kwa aibu. \q Mataifa yote yanayoizunguka yataicheka na kushangaa kwa hofu juu ya yaliyoipata.

vi.L: Nó bị đập tan thể nào! Chúng than van! \q Mô-áp quay lưng hổ thẹn thể nào! \q Mô-áp sẽ thành trò cười và nỗi kinh hoàng cho mọi kẻ chung quanh nó.
vi.B: Nó tan nát biết bao! Chúng than van biết bao! \q Mô-áp quay lưng bỏ chạy trong nhục nhã biết bao! \q Mô-áp sẽ thành trò cười và nỗi kinh hoàng cho mọi lân bang.
vi.R: Mô-áp đã tan nát! Hãy nghe dân nó than van! \q Mô-áp đã quay lưng bỏ chạy trong nhục nhã. \q Mọi dân tộc chung quanh sẽ cười nhạo nó và kinh hãi về điều đã xảy đến cho nó.

ko.L: 어찌 그렇게 부서졌는가! 그들이 울부짖는다! \q 모압이 부끄러워 어찌 등을 돌렸는가! \q 모압이 그 주위의 모든 자에게 웃음거리와 공포가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 얼마나 산산이 부서졌는가! 얼마나 울부짖는가! \q 모압이 부끄러워 얼마나 등을 돌려 달아났는가! \q 모압은 그 주위의 모든 이웃에게 웃음거리와 공포의 대상이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 모압이 부서졌다! 그 백성이 울부짖는 소리를 들어 보아라! \q 모압은 부끄러워서 돌아서서 달아났다. \q 모압 주위의 모든 나라가 모압을 비웃고, 모압에 일어난 일을 보고 끔찍해할 것이다.

decisions.choice: how it is shattered! they wail!: a lament
decisions.reason: "How" opens a cry of lament, as in verse 17. "They wail" may also be a command, "Wail!", as in verse 20; the form is the same.

decisions.choice: turned its back: fled in defeat
decisions.reason: To turn the back is to run from the enemy (Joshua 7:8, 12). Moab's warriors, who boasted in verse 14, flee in shame.

decisions.choice: a laughingstock and a horror: mocked and dreaded
decisions.reason: Moab becomes the laughingstock it made of Israel (verses 26-27), and also a terror: its neighbors are frightened by its fall.

decisions.choice: Hear how its people wail ... All the nations around it
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the subjects the Hebrew leaves unstated.

source.text: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה כַנֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּפָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו אֶל־מוֹאָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: Look, like the eagle he will swoop, and he will spread his wings against Moab.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Look, like an eagle he will swoop down \q and spread his wings against Moab.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q Look! Like an eagle he swoops down \q and spreads his wings over Moab.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q Look! The enemy will swoop down like an eagle \q and spread his wings over Moab.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q He aquí, como águila volará \q y extenderá sus alas contra Moab.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q ¡He aquí! Como un águila se lanza \q y extiende sus alas sobre Moab.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q ¡Atención! El enemigo se lanzará como un águila \q y extenderá sus alas sobre Moab.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Voici, comme un aigle il fondra \q et déploiera ses ailes contre Moab.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Voici ! Comme un aigle, il fond sur sa proie \q et déploie ses ailes au-dessus de Moab.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Regardez ! L’ennemi va fondre comme un aigle \q et déployer ses ailes au-dessus de Moab.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Tazama, kama tai atashuka kwa kasi, \q na kuyakunjua mabawa yake juu ya Moabu.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Tazama! Kama tai anashuka kwa kasi \q na kuyakunjua mabawa yake juu ya Moabu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Tazama! Adui atashuka kwa kasi kama tai \q na kuyakunjua mabawa yake juu ya Moabu.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Này, nó sẽ sà xuống như chim đại bàng \q và dang cánh ra nghịch cùng Mô-áp.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Kìa! Nó sà xuống như chim đại bàng \q và dang cánh trên Mô-áp.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Hãy xem! Quân thù sẽ sà xuống như chim đại bàng \q và dang cánh trên Mô-áp.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 보라, 그가 독수리처럼 날아 내려와 \q 모압을 향하여 날개를 펼칠 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 보라! 그가 독수리처럼 날쌔게 내려와 \q 모압 위에 날개를 펼친다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 보아라! 원수가 독수리처럼 날쌔게 내려와 \q 모압 위에 날개를 펼칠 것이다.

decisions.choice: like an eagle he will swoop and spread his wings: the invader's sudden attack
decisions.reason: The bird may be an eagle or a vulture. The conqueror, Babylon's king, is pictured diving on its prey and covering it with its wings (4:13; Deuteronomy 28:49; Habakkuk 1:8). "He" is not named; it is the destroyer of the chapter, not the LORD.

decisions.choice: the same words return in 49:22, against Edom
decisions.reason: Verses 40b and 41b reappear almost word for word in 49:22, where they are said of Bozrah and Edom.

decisions.choice: the eagle lines: lacking in the ancient Greek translation
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation has "For thus says the LORD" but lacks the eagle line here and the line about the warriors' hearts in verse 41; it has them at 49:22 (in its own order). They may have been added here in the Hebrew from 49:22, or left out of the Greek because they appear there. This claim is given from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: The enemy
decisions.reason: Readable names the one pictured as an eagle (m1).

decisions.choice: over Moab
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "to", "over" or "against". Balanced and Readable say "over", which suits wings spread over prey; Literal keeps "against".

source.text: נִלְכְּדָה֙ הַקְּרִיּ֔וֹת וְהַמְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה וְֽ֠הָיָה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Is captured the Kerioth, and the strongholds are seized; and will be [the] heart of [the] warriors of Moab in that day like [the] heart of a woman in labor.

en.L: Kerioth is captured, \q and the strongholds are seized; \q and the heart of the warriors of Moab on that day will be \q like the heart of a woman in labor.
en.B: Kerioth is taken, \q the strongholds are seized. \q On that day the warriors of Moab will have hearts \q like the heart of a woman in labor.
en.R: Kerioth is captured. \q The forts are taken. \q On that day the soldiers of Moab will be terrified, \q like a woman giving birth.

es.L: Tomada es Queriot, \q y las fortalezas son ocupadas; \q y el corazón de los valientes de Moab será en aquel día \q como el corazón de mujer en parto.
es.B: Queriot ha sido tomada, \q las fortalezas han sido ocupadas. \q Aquel día los guerreros de Moab tendrán el corazón \q como el de una mujer de parto.
es.R: Queriot ha sido conquistada. \q Los fuertes han sido tomados. \q Ese día los soldados de Moab estarán aterrados, \q como una mujer que está dando a luz.

fr.L: Qerioth est prise, \q et les forteresses sont saisies ; \q et le cœur des guerriers de Moab sera en ce jour-là \q comme le cœur d’une femme en travail.
fr.B: Qerioth est prise, \q les forteresses sont saisies. \q Ce jour-là, le cœur des guerriers de Moab sera \q comme le cœur d’une femme qui accouche.
fr.R: Qerioth est prise. \q Les forteresses sont tombées. \q Ce jour-là, les soldats de Moab seront terrifiés, \q comme une femme qui met un enfant au monde.

sw.L: Keriothi imetwaliwa, \q na ngome zimekamatwa; \q na moyo wa mashujaa wa Moabu katika siku ile utakuwa \q kama moyo wa mwanamke aliye katika uchungu wa kuzaa.
sw.B: Keriothi imetekwa, \q ngome zimekamatwa. \q Siku hiyo mashujaa wa Moabu watakuwa na mioyo \q kama moyo wa mwanamke aliye katika uchungu wa kuzaa.
sw.R: Keriothi imetekwa. \q Ngome zimechukuliwa. \q Wakati huo askari wa Moabu wataogopa sana, \q kama mwanamke anayejifungua.

vi.L: Kê-ri-giốt bị chiếm lấy, \q các đồn lũy bị chiếm đoạt; \q trong ngày ấy lòng các dũng sĩ Mô-áp sẽ \q như lòng người đàn bà đang chuyển dạ.
vi.B: Kê-ri-giốt bị chiếm, \q các đồn lũy bị đoạt. \q Trong ngày ấy, lòng các dũng sĩ Mô-áp sẽ \q như lòng người đàn bà đang đau đẻ.
vi.R: Kê-ri-giốt bị chiếm. \q Các đồn lũy bị đoạt. \q Vào ngày ấy, quân lính Mô-áp sẽ kinh hãi \q như người đàn bà đang sinh con.

ko.L: 그리옷이 점령되고, \q 요새들이 함락되었다. \q 그날에 모압 용사들의 마음은 \q 해산하는 여자의 마음 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그리옷이 점령되고, \q 요새들이 함락되었다. \q 그날에 모압 용사들의 마음은 \q 해산하는 여자의 마음 같을 것이다.
ko.R: 그리옷이 점령되었다. \q 요새들이 함락되었다. \q 그때에 모압 군인들은 \q 아기를 낳는 여자처럼 몹시 두려워할 것이다.

decisions.choice: Kerioth: the town of verse 24, or "the towns"
decisions.reason: The word has the article, "the Kerioth". It is most likely the town named in verse 24 and Amos 2:2. It can also be the plural of the word for town: "the towns are captured".

decisions.choice: like the heart of a woman in labor: helpless terror
decisions.reason: As in 30:6 and 49:22, the pains of childbirth picture sudden, overwhelming fear. The warriors who boasted (verse 14) are shaken. 49:22 repeats this line of Edom's warriors (see verse 40).

decisions.choice: will be terrified, like a woman giving birth
decisions.reason: Readable says what the comparison means (m2).

decisions.choice: en aquel día (L); aquel día (B); ese día (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase as set in the terms note.

decisions.choice: "katika siku ile" (L); "siku hiyo" (B); "wakati huo" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the Swahili prophets.

decisions.choice: "그날에" (L, B); "그때에" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "in that day".

source.text: וְנִשְׁמַ֥ד מוֹאָ֖ב מֵעָ֑ם כִּ֥י עַל־יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be destroyed Moab from [being] a people, for against Yahweh he magnified himself.

en.L: And Moab will be destroyed from [being] a people, \q for against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} he has made himself great.
en.B: Moab will be destroyed and no longer be a people, \q because he exalted himself against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Moab will be destroyed and will no longer be a nation, \q because it made itself proud against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Moab será destruido para dejar de ser pueblo, \q porque contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se engrandeció.
es.B: Moab será destruido y dejará de ser un pueblo, \q porque se engrandeció contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Moab será destruido y dejará de ser una nación, \q porque se llenó de orgullo contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Moab sera détruit, [il ne sera plus] un peuple, \q car contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} il s’est élevé.
fr.B: Moab sera détruit et ne sera plus un peuple, \q parce qu’il s’est élevé contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Moab sera détruit et ne sera plus une nation, \q parce qu’il s’est montré orgueilleux contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Moabu ataangamizwa asiwe watu, \q kwa maana amejitukuza juu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Moabu itaangamizwa wala haitakuwa watu tena, \q kwa sababu ilijitukuza dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Moabu itaangamizwa wala haitakuwa taifa tena, \q kwa sababu ilijivuna dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Mô-áp sẽ bị hủy diệt, không còn [là] một dân, \q vì nó đã tự tôn mình lên nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Mô-áp sẽ bị hủy diệt, không còn là một dân nữa, \q vì nó đã tự tôn mình lên chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Mô-áp sẽ bị hủy diệt và không còn là một dân tộc nữa, \q vì nó đã kiêu ngạo chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 모압이 멸망하여 백성이 되지 못할 것이다. \q 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맞서 스스로 높였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 모압은 멸망하여 다시는 한 백성이 되지 못할 것이다. \q 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맞서 교만하게 굴었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 모압은 멸망하여 더 이상 나라가 되지 못할 것이다. \q 모압이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맞서 교만하게 굴었기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: destroyed from being a people: Moab will no longer exist as a nation
decisions.reason: The phrase answers the plotters' words in verse 2, "let us cut her off from being a nation". The reason repeats verse 26.

decisions.choice: the wording of verse 26
decisions.reason: Each level repeats its wording of verse 26 for the same clause.

source.text: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֛יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Terror and pit and snare [are] upon you, inhabitant of Moab, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Terror and pit and snare \q [are] upon you, inhabitant of Moab, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Fear and the pit and the trap \q are upon you who live in Moab, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: All of you who live in Moab, \q terror, a deep pit, and a trap are waiting for you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Terror, fosa y trampa \q [hay] sobre ti, morador de Moab, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: El terror, la fosa y la trampa \q te esperan a ti, habitante de Moab, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que viven en Moab: \q el terror, un pozo profundo y una trampa {{plural_you:los|os}} esperan, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: La terreur, la fosse et le piège \q [sont] sur toi, habitant de Moab, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: La terreur, la fosse et le piège \q sont sur toi qui habites Moab, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous tous qui habitez en Moab, \q la terreur, une fosse profonde et un piège vous attendent, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hofu na shimo na mtego \q [viko] juu yako, ewe mkaaji wa Moabu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hofu, shimo na mtego \q viko juu yenu mnaoishi Moabu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Enyi nyote mnaoishi Moabu, \q hofu, shimo refu na mtego vinawangojea, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Kinh hoàng, hầm hố và cạm bẫy \q [ở] trên ngươi, hỡi dân cư Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Sợ hãi, hầm hố và cạm bẫy \q đang chờ ngươi, hỡi dân cư Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả dân Mô-áp, \q kinh hoàng, hố sâu và cạm bẫy đang chờ các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 모압에 사는 자야, 공포와 함정과 올무가 \q 너에게 [닥쳤다]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 모압에 사는 자야, 공포와 함정과 덫이 \q 너에게 닥쳤다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 모압에 사는 모든 사람들아, \q 공포와 깊은 구덩이와 덫이 너희를 기다리고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: terror and pit and snare: Isaiah 24:17 taken up
decisions.reason: Verses 43-44 repeat Isaiah 24:17-18. Isaiah speaks to "the inhabitant of the earth"; here it is "the inhabitant of Moab", and "declares the LORD" is added. The three Hebrew words sound almost alike (pachad, pachat, pach), so the line rings like an alarm.

decisions.choice: inhabitant of Moab: all who live there
decisions.reason: The word is singular but means the whole people, addressed together.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 24:17
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Isaiah 24:17 wording, with Moab in place of the earth.

decisions.choice: Terror, fosa y trampa
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sounds alike (*paḥad, paḥat, paḥ*), as in Isaiah 24:17; Spanish keeps three short nouns but not the sound play.

decisions.choice: "공포와 함정과 올무" (L), "공포와 함정과 덫" (B)
decisions.reason: Three words kept apart as in the Korean draft of Isaiah 24:17-18, which the meaning decision says is taken up here.

source.text: הַנָּ֞ס מִפְּנֵ֤י הַפַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעֹלֶה֙ מִן־הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧יהָ אֶל־מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The [one who] flees from before the terror will fall into the pit, and the [one who] goes up from the pit will be caught in the snare; for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, [the] year of their punishment, declares Yahweh.

en.L: The one fleeing from before the terror will fall into the pit, \q and the one coming up from the pit will be caught in the snare; \q for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, the year of their punishment, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Anyone who runs from the fear will drop into the pit, \q and anyone who climbs up out of the pit will be caught in the trap. \q For I will bring on her, on Moab, the year of their punishment, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Anyone who runs away from the terror will fall into the pit. \q Anyone who climbs out of the pit will be caught in the trap. \q I will bring this on Moab when the time comes to punish them, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: El que huya del terror caerá en la fosa, \q y el que suba de la fosa será atrapado en la trampa; \q porque yo traeré sobre ella, sobre Moab, el año de su castigo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: El que huya del terror caerá en la fosa, \q y el que salga de la fosa quedará atrapado en la trampa. \q Porque traeré sobre ella, sobre Moab, el año de su castigo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: El que huya del terror caerá en el pozo. \q El que salga del pozo quedará atrapado en la trampa. \q Traeré esto sobre Moab cuando llegue el tiempo de castigarlos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Celui qui fuit devant la terreur tombera dans la fosse, \q et celui qui remonte de la fosse sera pris au piège ; \q car je ferai venir sur elle, sur Moab, l’année de leur châtiment, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Celui qui fuit devant la terreur tombera dans la fosse, \q et celui qui remonte de la fosse sera pris au piège. \q Car je ferai venir sur elle, sur Moab, l’année de leur châtiment, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Celui qui s’enfuit devant la terreur tombera dans la fosse. \q Celui qui sortira de la fosse sera pris au piège. \q Je ferai venir cela sur Moab quand le moment sera venu de les punir, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Yeye akimbiaye mbele ya hofu ataanguka shimoni, \q naye apandaye kutoka shimoni atanaswa mtegoni; \q kwa maana nitaleta juu yake, juu ya Moabu, mwaka wa kuadhibiwa kwao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Yeyote anayekimbia hofu ataangukia shimoni, \q na yeyote anayepanda kutoka shimoni atanaswa mtegoni. \q Kwa maana nitaleta juu yake, juu ya Moabu, mwaka wa kuadhibiwa kwao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Yeyote anayekimbia hofu ataanguka shimoni. \q Yeyote anayepanda kutoka shimoni atanaswa mtegoni. \q Nitaleta haya juu ya Moabu wakati wa kuwaadhibu utakapofika, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Kẻ chạy trốn khỏi sự kinh hoàng sẽ rơi xuống hầm, \q kẻ leo lên khỏi hầm sẽ mắc vào bẫy; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng trên nó, trên Mô-áp, năm chúng bị phạt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Kẻ nào chạy trốn nỗi sợ hãi sẽ sa xuống hầm, \q kẻ nào leo lên khỏi hầm sẽ mắc bẫy. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng trên nó, trên Mô-áp, năm chúng bị trừng phạt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ai chạy trốn nỗi kinh hoàng sẽ rơi xuống hố. \q Ai leo lên khỏi hố sẽ mắc bẫy. \q Ta sẽ giáng điều ấy trên Mô-áp khi đến lúc trừng phạt chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 공포 앞에서 도망하는 자는 함정에 빠지고, \q 함정에서 올라오는 자는 올무에 걸릴 것이다. \q 내가 그에게, 곧 모압에게 그들이 벌받을 해를 내릴 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 공포를 피하여 달아나는 자는 함정에 빠지고, \q 함정에서 기어 올라오는 자는 덫에 걸릴 것이다. \q 내가 모압에게 그들이 벌받을 해가 닥치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 공포를 피하여 달아나는 사람은 구덩이에 빠질 것이다. \q 구덩이에서 기어 나오는 사람은 덫에 걸릴 것이다. \q 그들을 벌할 때가 되면, 내가 모압에 이런 일이 일어나게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: whoever flees falls into the pit: Isaiah 24:18 taken up
decisions.reason: Isaiah 24:18 begins "and it will be" and has "from the sound of the terror" and "from the midst of the pit"; this verse has "from before the terror" and "from the pit". In place of Isaiah's flood picture it ends with the year of Moab's punishment. Escaping one danger only leads into the next (Amos 5:19).

decisions.choice: the year of their punishment: the time set for their judgment
decisions.reason: As in 11:23 and 23:12, "year" means the appointed time when God deals with them.

decisions.choice: the one who flees: the reading of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The written text spells the word slightly differently; the reading tradition gives "the one who flees", as in Isaiah 24:18.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 24:18 and 11:23
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its Isaiah 24:18 wording where the Hebrew is the same, and its wording of 11:23 for "the year of their punishment".

source.text: בְּצֵ֥ל חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עָמְד֖וּ מִכֹּ֣חַ נָסִ֑ים כִּֽי־אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְלֶֽהָבָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַתֹּ֨אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְקָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] shadow of Heshbon stand without strength fugitives; for fire has gone out from Heshbon, and flame from [the] midst of Sihon, and it has consumed [the] forehead of Moab and [the] crown of the head of [the] sons of tumult.

en.L: In the shadow of Heshbon fugitives stand without strength; \q for fire went out from Heshbon, and flame from the midst of Sihon, \q and it consumed the forehead of Moab \q and the crown of the head of the {{gender:children|sons}} of tumult.
en.B: In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand, their strength spent, \q for fire went out from Heshbon, a flame from the midst of Sihon. \q It burned up the forehead of Moab, \q the skulls of the {{gender:people|sons}} of tumult.
en.R: The refugees stop in the shade of Heshbon. They have no strength left. \q But fire came out of Heshbon, flames from the city of Sihon. \q It burned up Moab's forehead \q and the heads of its proud, noisy people.

es.L: A la sombra de Hesbón se detienen sin fuerzas los fugitivos; \q porque salió fuego de Hesbón, y llama de en medio de Sehón, \q y consumió la frente de Moab \q y la coronilla de los hijos del tumulto.
es.B: A la sombra de Hesbón se detienen los fugitivos, sin fuerzas, \q porque salió fuego de Hesbón, una llama de en medio de Sehón. \q Devoró la frente de Moab, \q el cráneo de los hijos del alboroto.
es.R: Los refugiados se detienen a la sombra de Hesbón. Ya no les quedan fuerzas. \q Pero salió fuego de Hesbón, llamas de la ciudad de Sehón. \q Quemó la frente de Moab \q y la cabeza de su gente orgullosa y escandalosa.

fr.L: À l’ombre de Heshbon des fuyards s’arrêtent, sans force ; \q car un feu est sorti de Heshbon, et une flamme du milieu de Sihôn, \q et il a dévoré le front de Moab \q et le crâne des {{gender:enfants|fils}} du tumulte.
fr.B: À l’ombre de Heshbon, les fuyards s’arrêtent, à bout de forces, \q car un feu est sorti de Heshbon, une flamme du milieu de Sihôn. \q Il a dévoré le front de Moab, \q le crâne des {{gender:gens|fils}} du tumulte.
fr.R: Les réfugiés s’arrêtent à l’ombre de Heshbon. Ils n’ont plus de forces. \q Mais un feu est sorti de Heshbon, des flammes de la ville de Sihôn. \q Il a brûlé le front de Moab \q et la tête de son peuple orgueilleux et bruyant.

sw.L: Katika kivuli cha Heshboni wakimbizi wanasimama bila nguvu; \q kwa maana moto ulitoka Heshboni, na mwali kutoka katikati ya Sihoni, \q ukaila paji la uso la Moabu \q na utosi wa kichwa cha wana wa ghasia.
sw.B: Katika kivuli cha Heshboni wakimbizi wanasimama, nguvu zao zimekwisha, \q kwa maana moto ulitoka Heshboni, mwali kutoka katikati ya Sihoni. \q Ukaliteketeza paji la uso la Moabu, \q mafuvu ya watu wa ghasia.
sw.R: Wakimbizi wanasimama kivulini mwa Heshboni. Hawana nguvu tena. \q Lakini moto ulitoka Heshboni, miali kutoka mji wa Sihoni. \q Uliteketeza paji la uso la Moabu \q na vichwa vya watu wake wenye kiburi na makelele.

vi.L: Dưới bóng Hết-bôn, những kẻ chạy trốn đứng lại, kiệt sức; \q vì lửa đã ra từ Hết-bôn, ngọn lửa từ giữa Si-hôn, \q và nó đã thiêu đốt trán của Mô-áp \q và đỉnh đầu của con cái huyên náo.
vi.B: Dưới bóng Hết-bôn, những kẻ chạy trốn đứng lại, sức cùng lực kiệt, \q vì lửa đã ra từ Hết-bôn, ngọn lửa từ giữa Si-hôn. \q Nó đã thiêu đốt trán của Mô-áp, \q đỉnh đầu của bọn người huyên náo.
vi.R: Những người tị nạn dừng lại dưới bóng Hết-bôn. Họ không còn chút sức lực nào. \q Nhưng lửa đã ra từ Hết-bôn, ngọn lửa từ thành của Si-hôn. \q Nó đã thiêu đốt trán của Mô-áp \q và đầu của dân nó, là dân kiêu căng và ồn ào.

ko.L: 헤스본 그늘 아래 도망자들이 힘없이 서 있다. \q 불이 헤스본에서, 불꽃이 시혼 가운데서 나와서, \q 모압의 이마와 \q 소란한 {{gender:자손|아들들}}의 정수리를 삼켰다.
ko.B: 도망자들이 힘이 다 빠진 채 헤스본 그늘 아래 서 있다. \q 불이 헤스본에서 나오고, 불꽃이 시혼 가운데서 나와서, \q 모압의 이마와 \q 소란한 {{gender:자손|아들들}}의 정수리를 태워 버렸다.
ko.R: 피난민들이 헤스본 그늘에 멈추어 선다. 그들에게는 힘이 하나도 남지 않았다. \q 그러나 헤스본에서 불이 나오고, 시혼이 다스리던 성에서 불꽃이 나왔다. \q 그 불이 모압의 이마를 태우고, \q 교만하고 떠들썩한 백성의 머리를 태워 버렸다.

decisions.choice: fire from Heshbon, flame from Sihon: the song of Numbers 21:28 taken up
decisions.reason: Numbers 21:28 sings of the Amorite king Sihon's victory over Moab: "fire went out from Heshbon, flame from the town of Sihon; it consumed Ar of Moab". Here "from the midst of Sihon" stands for "from the town of Sihon", and the fire consumes "the forehead of Moab". The old victory song becomes a prophecy of Moab's fall again.

decisions.choice: the forehead of Moab and the skull of the sons of tumult: Balaam's oracle, Numbers 24:17
decisions.reason: Balaam said the star from Jacob "will crush the forehead of Moab and tear down all the sons of Sheth" (Numbers 24:17). This verse has "the crown of the head" for "tear down", a word that looks much the same, and "the sons of tumult" for "the sons of Sheth", which may be how the line was understood: Moab's noisy, boastful people or warriors.

decisions.choice: in the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand without strength: no refuge left
decisions.reason: Refugees stop exhausted in the shade of Heshbon, hoping for shelter; but fire comes out of the very city where they seek it. Heshbon, once Sihon's capital, was now in Moabite hands (verse 2).

decisions.choice: verses 45-47: lacking in the ancient Greek translation
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation ends the oracle with verse 44 and has nothing of verses 45-47. This claim is given from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: children / people of tumult, with "sons" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 24:17, "sons of" names a whole people, so the gender setting applies.

decisions.choice: flames from the city of Sihon
decisions.reason: Readable keeps its Numbers 21:28 wording; "the midst of Sihon" means Sihon's own city (m1).

decisions.choice: los hijos del tumulto (L); los hijos del alboroto (B)
decisions.reason: "Hijos" includes all the people, so the English gender setting needs no span; the verse recalls the old song of Numbers 21:28.

decisions.choice: "wana wa ghasia" (L), "watu wa ghasia" (B), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: "Wana" and "watu" already include women; there is no second Swahili wording for the setting to offer.

decisions.choice: con cái huyên náo (L); bọn người huyên náo (B)
decisions.reason: "Sons of tumult" are the noisy, boastful people; Vietnamese "con cái" and "người" include all, so no gender span is needed. Si-hôn is the published form of Joshua 12:2.
