records.literal_gloss: Woe to you, Moab! Has perished [the] people of Chemosh; for are taken your sons into captivity, and your daughters into captivity.

en.L: Woe to you, Moab! \q The people of Chemosh have perished; \q for your sons have been taken into captivity, \q and your daughters into captivity.
en.B: Woe to you, Moab! \q The people of Chemosh are destroyed. \q Your sons have been taken away as captives, \q and your daughters carried off into captivity.
en.R: How terrible it will be for you, Moab! \q The people who worship Chemosh are destroyed. \q Your sons have been taken away as prisoners, \q and your daughters too.

es.L: ¡Ay de ti, Moab! \q Pereció el pueblo de Quemos; \q porque tus hijos fueron llevados en cautiverio, \q y tus hijas en cautividad.
es.B: ¡Ay de ti, Moab! \q El pueblo de Quemos ha sido destruido. \q Tus hijos han sido llevados cautivos, \q y tus hijas al cautiverio.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para ti, Moab! \q La gente que adora a Quemos está destruida. \q Tus hijos han sido llevados prisioneros, \q y tus hijas también.

fr.L: Malheur à toi, Moab ! \q Le peuple de Kemosh a péri ; \q car tes fils ont été emmenés en captivité, \q et tes filles en captivité.
fr.B: Malheur à toi, Moab ! \q Le peuple de Kemosh est anéanti. \q Tes fils ont été emmenés captifs, \q et tes filles déportées en captivité.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour toi, Moab ! \q Le peuple qui adore Kemosh est détruit. \q Tes fils ont été emmenés prisonniers, \q et tes filles aussi.

sw.L: Ole wako, Moabu! \q Watu wa Kemoshi wameangamia; \q kwa maana wana wako wamechukuliwa utumwani, \q na binti zako utumwani.
sw.B: Ole wako, Moabu! \q Watu wa Kemoshi wameangamizwa. \q Wana wako wamechukuliwa mateka, \q na binti zako wamepelekwa utumwani.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwako, Moabu! \q Watu wanaomwabudu Kemoshi wameangamizwa. \q Wana wako wamechukuliwa kama wafungwa, \q na binti zako pia.

vi.L: Khốn cho ngươi, hỡi Mô-áp! \q Dân của Kê-móc đã bị diệt vong; \q vì các con trai ngươi bị bắt đi lưu đày, \q và các con gái ngươi bị bắt đi lưu đày.
vi.B: Khốn cho ngươi, hỡi Mô-áp! \q Dân của Kê-móc đã bị hủy diệt. \q Các con trai ngươi bị bắt đi làm tù binh, \q các con gái ngươi bị đem đi lưu đày.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho ngươi, hỡi Mô-áp! \q Dân thờ thần Kê-móc đã bị hủy diệt. \q Các con trai ngươi bị bắt đi làm tù binh, \q các con gái ngươi cũng vậy.

ko.L: 모압아, 너에게 화가 있다! \q 그모스의 백성이 망했다. \q 네 아들들이 포로로 잡혀가고, \q 네 딸들이 포로로 [잡혀갔다].
ko.B: 모압아, 너에게 화가 있다! \q 그모스의 백성이 멸망했다. \q 네 아들들이 포로로 끌려가고, \q 네 딸들도 사로잡혀 갔다.
ko.R: 모압아, 너에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! \q 그모스를 섬기는 백성이 멸망했다. \q 네 아들들이 포로로 끌려갔다. \q 네 딸들도 끌려갔다.

decisions.choice: woe to you, Moab, people of Chemosh: Numbers 21:29 taken up
decisions.reason: Numbers 21:29 has "Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity". Here it is "the people of Chemosh have perished", and the sons and daughters "have been taken" captive, with no mention of Chemosh giving them up or of Sihon.

decisions.choice: woe: a cry of grief and doom
decisions.reason: The word here is a close relative of the cry in verse 1, said over those facing disaster (13:27; Numbers 21:29).

decisions.choice: the people of Chemosh: Moab, named by its god
decisions.reason: As in verse 7 and Numbers 21:29, Moab is called by the name of the god it served, who cannot save it.

decisions.choice: Woe to you (B); How terrible it will be for you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow Jeremiah's wording for this cry (13:27) rather than Numbers 21:29, where Balanced has "How terrible for you".

source.text: וְשַׁבְתִּ֧י שְׁבוּת־מוֹאָ֛ב בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה עַד־הֵ֖נָּה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will turn back [the] captivity of Moab in [the] latter part of the days, declares Yahweh. To here [is the] judgment of Moab.

en.L: Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in the latter days, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Thus far [is] the judgment of Moab.
en.B: Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
en.R: But later on I will make things good again for Moab, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This is the end of the message of judgment on Moab.

es.L: Pero restauraré la suerte de Moab en los últimos días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Hasta aquí [es] el juicio de Moab.
es.B: Pero en los días venideros restauraré la suerte de Moab, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Aquí termina el juicio sobre Moab.
es.R: Pero más adelante haré que todo vuelva a ir bien para Moab, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Aquí termina el mensaje de juicio sobre Moab.

fr.L: Mais je rétablirai le sort de Moab dans la suite des jours, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Jusqu’ici [est] le jugement de Moab.
fr.B: Mais je rétablirai le sort de Moab dans les jours à venir, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ici finit le jugement sur Moab.
fr.R: Mais plus tard, je rendrai Moab de nouveau heureux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ici finit le message de jugement contre Moab.

sw.L: Lakini nitairudishia Moabu mafanikio yake katika siku za mwisho, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hata hapa [ndiyo] hukumu ya Moabu.
sw.B: Lakini nitairudishia Moabu mafanikio yake katika siku zijazo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hapa ndipo mwisho wa hukumu juu ya Moabu.
sw.R: Lakini baadaye nitayafanya mambo ya Moabu kuwa mema tena, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Huu ndio mwisho wa ujumbe wa hukumu juu ya Moabu.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của Mô-áp trong những ngày sau rốt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Sự phán xét Mô-áp đến đây là hết.
vi.B: Nhưng trong những ngày sắp tới {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phục hồi cơ đồ của Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Sự phán xét Mô-áp kết thúc tại đây.
vi.R: Nhưng về sau {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho Mô-áp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Sứ điệp phán xét Mô-áp kết thúc tại đây.

ko.L: 그러나 마지막 날들에 내가 모압의 운명을 돌이키겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 여기까지가 모압에 대한 심판이다.
ko.B: 그러나 훗날에 내가 모압의 형편을 회복시키겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 모압에 대한 심판은 여기서 끝난다.
ko.R: 그러나 나중에 나는 모압을 다시 잘되게 해 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 모압에 대한 심판의 말씀은 여기서 끝난다.

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes: turn ruin into well-being
decisions.reason: The same phrase as in 30:3 (see the note there), used of Israel and Judah, is here promised to Moab, as it is also to Ammon (49:6) and Elam (49:39). The judgment is not God's last word for the nation.

decisions.choice: the latter days: the time to come, after the judgment
decisions.reason: As in 23:20 and 30:24, the phrase means the later part of time, the future as seen from now.

decisions.choice: thus far the judgment of Moab: a closing note
decisions.reason: The last words close the oracle like a heading at its end, as 51:64 closes the words of Jeremiah. "Judgment" names the whole oracle on Moab. The verse is a prose ending to the poem and is not set in lines.

decisions.choice: restore the fortunes (L, B); make things good again (R); the latter days / days to come / later on
decisions.reason: The wording settled at 30:3 for "restore the fortunes", and each level's wording of 30:24 for "the latter days".

decisions.choice: restauraré la suerte (L, B); haré que todo vuelva a ir bien (R)
decisions.reason: *Shuv shevut* in the wording set for Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "nitairudishia Moabu mafanikio yake" (L, B); "nitayafanya mambo ya Moabu kuwa mema tena" (R)
decisions.reason: *shuv shevut* ("restore the fortunes") in the wording used throughout Jeremiah (29:14; 30:3, 18; 33:7, 26): "kurudishia mafanikio" at Literal and Balanced, "kuyafanya mambo kuwa mema tena" at Readable, as Psalm 85:2 R. 49:6 and 49:39 follow.

decisions.choice: "je rétablirai le sort de" (L, B); "je rendrai ... de nouveau heureux" (R)
decisions.reason: *Shuv shevut* as everywhere in French Jeremiah (29:14; 30:3; 33:7): "rétablir le sort" at Literal and Balanced for "restore the fortunes", "rendre de nouveau heureux" at Readable for "make things good again".

decisions.choice: phục hồi cơ đồ (L, B); làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho ... (R)
decisions.reason: *Shuv shevut* is read as the English reads it: restoring fortunes. The wording is the one used for Israel in 29:14; 30:3; 33:7, 26 and for Ammon and Elam in 49:6, 39.

decisions.choice: "운명을 돌이키다" (L); "형편을 회복시키다" (B); "다시 잘되게 해 주다" (R) for *shuv shevut*
decisions.reason: The English note's "restore the fortunes" / "make things good again"; the same Korean wording serves 49:6 and 49:39.
